stories.title: Horrific road accident in Mirzapur, 6 burns alive:Bolero catches fire after truck collision; occupants could not escape the vehicle
stories.summary: A horrific road accident took place in Mirzapur on Wednesday night, in which 6 people were burnt alive. A truck carrying chickpeas from Madhya Pradesh reportedly suffered brake failure and went out of control. The truck rammed into a Bolero, which then crashed into a gravel-laden trailer ahead. After the collision, the Bolero caught fire and was engulfed in flames. The incident occurred in the Drumandganj police station area. According to eyewitnesses, all occupants of the Bolero are feared dead, though the exact number of passengers is yet to be confirmed. The vehicle is said to be from Hata in the Jigna police station area. The truck driver was seriously injured and has been sent to the hospital. Police and fire brigade teams reached the spot after being informed, but intense flames hampered rescue operations. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has taken cognisance of the road accident and directed officials to expedite relief and rescue operations. Now, know the full sequence of events Around 9:30 pm on the Mirzapur–Rewa National Highway near Badka Mod, a truck loaded with chickpeas was passing through when its brakes suddenly failed. At the same time, a Bolero was descending a slope. The out-of-control truck rammed into the Bolero, pushing it into a gravel-laden truck ahead. The impact was so severe that the Bolero caught fire instantly. All passengers inside the Bolero got trapped and were burnt alive. The incident triggered panic at the scene. Locals rushed to help and began rescue efforts, but the intensity of the fire made it impossible to save anyone. On receiving information, SP Aparna Rajat Kaushik, CO Lalganj Amar Bahadur, along with police teams from Lalganj and Halia police stations, reached the spot. The fire was brought under control with the help of fire brigade teams, and police are currently working to identify the victims.

stories.title: Kanpur Police counts ₹3.5 crore in 2 hours:5 held for IPL betting; machine used for counting currency
stories.summary: In Kanpur, 5 accused involved in facilitating betting on IPL matches through a mobile app have been arrested. Police have recovered Rs 3.91 crore from them. The bookies had procured 3 note-counting machines worth Rs 35,000 each and one currency checking machine from Delhi. According to police, bundles of 146 notes of Rs 500, 21 notes of Rs 200, and 11 notes of Rs 100 were recovered from the accused. 6 police personnel counted the money in about 2 hours using 3 machines. Two accused, Kartik Lakhwani and Rajkumar, were facilitating betting on the illegal betting app. Kalpesh, Ravi Nai, and Vishnu were involved in bringing and taking cash. Meanwhile, the gang's ringleader Manish alias Professor is still absconding. Police are engaged in searching for him. Police arrested the accused late Tuesday night in the Fazalganj police station area. Police Commissioner Raghubir Lal disclosed this on Wednesday. Now the complete case in detail Caught from under Govindpuri bridge Police Commissioner Raghubir Lal said that complaints were being received about large-scale betting on IPL matches in the city. Surveillance and SWAT teams were activated on this. Late Tuesday night, information was received from an informer that a white Sonet car was parked under Govindpuri bridge. Two youths sitting in this car were running online betting on IPL matches through mobile phones. As soon as the information was received, the team cordoned off the area. Kartik Lakhwani, a resident of Kaushalpuri, and Rajkumar, a resident of Fazalganj, were sitting in the car. Police arrested both of them. From the accused's mobile, BETHUB 24.COM illegal betting app, various applications, WhatsApp chats and transaction data were found. Betting was being run from a rented house The accused told the police that my associates operate the betting business from a rented house located in Kidwai Nagar. After this, the police raided the house located in Kidwai Nagar. From here, Kalpesh, Ravi Nai and Vishnu, residents of Unja in Mehsana district of Gujarat, were arrested. During the raid, police recovered 3 crore 91 lakh 50 thousand cash, mobile phones, 3 currency counting machines from the house. One currency checking machine, 2 calculators, and a Sonet car (UP 78 GP 4757) were recovered. The Police Commissioner said that the accused were doing betting through online applications and websites. They used to create IDs in the app and give them to customers. Now understand the method of fraud.. The accused revealed that users open the website link on social media and download the app. After this, they create their ID on it. Then they place money on it. Those who won amounts up to 1 lakh in betting were given online money transactions. We used to handle this entire app. Amounts larger than one lakh were given offline. When someone placed more money, we would make them lose. The money received from betting was kept at a higher center located in Kidwai Nagar. Mastermind gave ID to Kartik and Rajkumar According to Police Commissioner Raghubir Lal, Kartik has a butter paper factory. Kartik and Rajkumar had obtained the master ID of the fake betting app from Manish alias Professor, a resident of Jabalpur. Both accused used to make people place bets, while Kalpesh, Ravi Nai and Vishnu did the work of bringing and taking cash. Manish used to pay Kalpesh, Ravi Nai and Vishnu a salary of 13 to 20 thousand every month. Police are searching for Manish. His last location was found in Pune. The Income Tax department has been informed about the amount recovered from the accused. The money will soon be handed over to the Income Tax department.

stories.title: PM Modi to visit Varanasi on April 28:Will address 50,000 women; BJP regional president holds meeting
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is coming on a visit to Varanasi on the upcoming 28th April. In view of this, BJP has intensified preparations. BJP Kashi region president Dilip Patel held an important meeting with office bearers on Wednesday. In this, the district and municipal units of Bharatiya Janata Party formulated a strategy to run a public outreach campaign up to booth level to make the women's conference historic. Will inaugurate and lay foundation stones of projects worth crores BJP Kashi region president Dilip Patel informed that the Prime Minister will reach Kashi in the afternoon on 28th April where he will inaugurate and lay foundation stones of projects worth crores at Banaras Locomotive Works (Bareka) and after that will address a grand women's conference. The PM will stay overnight in Kashi that day. After 10 am on 29th April, the Prime Minister will inaugurate the Tibetan Institute Rinpa Sengpa Hospital and Medical College and then leave for the inauguration of Ganga Expressway in Hardoi. Message of women's power will go across the country Dilip Patel said - Since 2014 till now, the Prime Minister has taken several historic steps to enhance women's empowerment, self-reliance and socio-political participation. He appealed to the maternal power that this conference will send a message of women's power across the country. 50 thousand women will participate Dilip Patel informed - To ensure participation of more than 50 thousand women in the women's conference, senior officials have been assigned responsibilities in all eight assembly constituencies of the district. Under this, District Panchayat President Poonam Maurya has been given responsibility for Rohaniya, Women's Front District President Vinita Singh for Sevapuri, and former District Panchayat President Aparajita Sonkar for Ajgara assembly constituency. Meanwhile, among regional officials, Pooja Dixit has been assigned responsibility for South, Khushboo Singh for North, and BJP leader Nirmala Singh Patel for Cantt assembly constituency. He informed - According to the organization, the series of meetings in the divisions has been completed and now the women's front teams will contact women house-to-house at the booth level to invite them to participate in the conference. BJP's goal is to give this conference a historic form, for which the organization has entered the field with full strength.

stories.title: 30-year-old actress Divyanka Sirohi dies in Ghaziabad:Fell after dizziness at home; worked in over 50 Haryanvi songs
stories.summary: Haryanvi actress Divyanka Sirohi (30) has passed away. Late on the night of April 21 (Tuesday), her health suddenly deteriorated at her home in Ghaziabad. She fell to the ground after feeling dizzy. This caused a deep injury to her head. Family members took her to the hospital, where doctors declared her dead. Her last rites were performed in Ghaziabad on Wednesday morning. Divyanka had worked in more than 50 Haryanvi songs. She had also worked with Masoom Sharma, Amit Saini Rohtakiya, and KD. She has 1.3 million followers on Instagram. Pictures of Divyanka Sirohi Family lives in Ghaziabad, UP Divyanka Sirohi was born on November 19, 1996 in Bulandshahr. Her family lives in Ghaziabad. Divyanka did her B.Com from Chaudhary Charan Singh University located in Meerut. After that she did MBA from Sikkim. Then she obtained a B.Ed degree from Gurugram. Divyanka has two brothers, Himanshu, Deepanshu and a sister Jasmeet. Her father Gajendra is a transporter and mother Anita is a housewife. Brother Himanshu told Dainik Bhaskar that Divyanka was at home on Tuesday night. Around 8 pm her health deteriorated and she fell on the floor. Due to the fall she suffered an internal head injury and started bleeding. When my younger brother Deepanshu reached her, her body had already turned cold. When taken to the hospital, doctors declared her dead. Singer Masoom Sharma introduced her from the stage Actress Divyanka Sirohi also shared the stage with singer Masoom Sharma at a live show in JCD, Sirsa. As soon as Divyanka arrived on stage, the audience present at the show gave her a loud round of applause. Masoom Sharma himself introduced Divyanka to the audience by taking her name. During this time, Divyanka remained on stage for quite a while. Read the story of Divyanka's entry into the Haryanvi industry... Started from TikTok, got 20 million views In an interview, Divyanka had said that I had a passion for acting and dancing since childhood. I made a video on TikTok on Diwali on Punjabi singer Sunanda Sharma's song 'Meri Mammy Nu Pasand Ni Tu'. This video went viral because of my expressions. That video got around 20 million views. After this, I had 5 million followers on TikTok. Got a job in 2018, then entered the film industry Divyanka had said about family support that she never felt that the family wouldn't support her. The family supported me in every way. I managed myself financially too. I also did a job in 2018. When I felt that I could do something in this industry, I quit the job. After that, the Haryanvi film industry began. Used to take brother along for shooting Regarding the industry, Divyanka had said that if you are fine, then everything is fine. You meet all kinds of people everywhere. For those who cannot manage, this line is dirty. I have a team. I take my brother along for shooting. Papa has diabetes, so he cannot go. About marriage, she had said - No intention right now On the question of marriage, Divyanka had said that whether it's a love marriage or arranged, one regrets after eating the wedding laddu and also regrets not eating it. Therefore, it's better to regret without eating it. Currently, I have no intention of getting married. After marriage, many things have to be managed. For my family, I am not like a daughter, but like a son. Actors expressed grief over actress Divyanka Sirohi's demise in this way... Manjeet Panchal wrote- She was an amazing artist Haryanvi artist Manjit Panchal has expressed grief over the demise of actress Divyanka Sirohi. He posted on his social media. It read - Haryanvi artist Divyanka Sirohi is no longer with us. She was an amazing artist, truly. At the end of the message, he also added crying emojis expressing sadness.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Pahalgam attack victim says no justice till terrorism is eradicated; Iran seizes India-bound ship in Strait of Hormuz more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. Iran seizes India-bound ship in Strait of Hormuz Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has reportedly fired at a container ship in the Strait of Hormuz, according to the UK Maritime Trade Operations Centre (UKMTO). The British Royal Navy-led UKMTO says the incident took place 15 nautical miles northeast of Oman. 2. 'I cannot forget the pain of a lifetime': One year after Pahalgam attack, victim Shubham Dwivedi's wife Aishanya says, 'No justice till terrorism is eradicated' The Pahalgam terrorist attack occurred exactly one year ago today on April 22. 30-year-old Shubham Dwivedi from Kanpur was shot in the head in front of his wife Aishanya. Shubham and Aishanya had been married for just two months.Tears come to Aishanya's eyes when she remembers Shubham. She says she could neither celebrate their anniversary nor any festival. 3. Fine on beard and long hair at Lucknow's Lohia Institute:₹2,000 fine for taking leave without informing; ₹500 fine for sleeping or smoking A major controversy has erupted over new rules issued for outsourced employees at Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Institute of Medical Sciences in Lucknow. According to the order issued by the agency, male employees will be fined Rs 200 for keeping a beard or long hair. Female employees will also have to pay a fine of Rs 200 for not keeping their hair in a bun or the prescribed hairstyle. 4. Amit Shah says, 'The more you abuse Modi, more brightly 'lotus' blooms' Union Home Minister Amit Shah, addressing a public meeting in Dum Dum on Wednesday, said that the more abuses are directed at Modi, the brighter ‘lotus’ will bloom. 5. Fighter aircraft show on Purvanchal Expressway: Air Force conducting war exercises in Sultanpur; 5 km area sealed, route diverted An air show of fighter aircraft is taking place today, i.e., Wednesday, on the Purvanchal Expressway in UP. The roar of Indian Air Force fighter jets can be heard on the airstrip built near Arwal Kiri Karwat village on the Purvanchal Expressway in Sultanpur. Nine fighter jets including Sukhoi, Mirage, Tejas, and Jaguar are performing takeoff and landing demonstrations. 6. Rinku Singh seeks IPL trophy as blessing from Baba Vishwanath: Sits among devotees for Ganga aarti, to marry MP Priya Saroj in June Kolkata Knight Riders' vice-captain Rinku Singh has embarked on a religious journey. He performed special prayers at the Kashi Vishwanath Temple for his team's victory. He stayed at the temple for half an hour, during which he was accompanied by his fiancé Priya Saroj and his teammate, Kolkata Knight Riders' all-rounder Anukul Roy. 7. SC says ‘Hindus should be united, not divided into sects’ The Supreme Court on Wednesday heard a case related to the entry of women into the Sabarimala temple. During the hearing, Justice VB Nagarathna said, “Hindu society should united, not divided into sects." 8. 'Lenskart owner is descendant of Aurangzeb': BJP MLA Nand Kishore reaches store in Ghaziabad, opposes dress code policy BJP MLA from Loni, Nandkishor Gurjar, reached a Lenskart showroom in Ghaziabad on Tuesday evening. He spoke with the employees working there and expressed opposition to the dress code. 9. Monkey sits holding newborn baby for 2 hours in Muzaffarnagar: Attempts to bite family members trying to save the child In Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh, a monkey sat inside a house holding a 3-month-old baby for two hours. The monkey began to caress the child, stroking him, and playing with him. After a while, when the family members returned from work and entered the room, they were startled by fear. This made the monkey aggressive. 10. UK bans smoking for people born after 2008 Britain has taken a major step to curb smoking, with the government passing the Tobacco and Vapes Bill aimed at preventing future generations from ever taking up the habit. The legislation ensures that people born after 2008 will be permanently barred from buying tobacco products.

stories.title: Yogi says Bengal’s identity is Maa Kali, not Kaaba:Targets Mamata over Lord Ram; Kolkata Mayor says Urdu will prevail
stories.summary: CM Yogi is in West Bengal on Wednesday. Here he held an election rally. During this, Yogi said, “When India became independent, the entire country used to come to Bengal for employment. After that, first Congress looted it, then the Communists tore apart this state. Now for 15 years, TMC has been making it bankrupt.” The CM said that aunt and nephew together want to destroy Bengal's existence. The Mayor of Kolkata says that Urdu will run here. I say no son of a mother can play with Bengali identity. Bengal's identity is not from Kaaba, but from Maa Kali Bari. During campaigning at Jorasanko and Chakdaha assembly seats, Yogi targeted the Mamata government fiercely. A child had arrived at Yogi's rally with a poster. It was written on it - Yogi ji bring the bulldozer, we are with you. Read the key points of CM Yogi's speech 1. Mamata Didi is irritated by the name of Ram CM Yogi said - Cow slaughter happens openly in Bengal. Mamata Didi is irritated by the name of Lord Ram. Permission is not given to take out processions. TMC goons collect goon tax. Such a situation existed in UP too. One had to pay tax to SP goons. Development was stalled, lathi-charge and bullets were fired on those who took Ram's name. Today there is celebration in UP. Somewhere Ram Navami celebration, somewhere Krishna Janmashtami celebration, somewhere Kanwar Yatra celebration. Everything is peaceful in UP, mafia and goons have ended. 2. Bulldozer makes a highway of the bones of mafia-goons In UP, when mafia and goons raise their heads, the bulldozer uses their bones and ribs to build highways. The land that goons had occupied on government property during Congress and SP's time, the poor's land was given back to the poor. Government land came back to the government. The whole world is coming to Kashi, Prayagraj. This only happens when there is a BJP double engine government. We have beautified Ayodhya-Kashi. In Bengal, TMC goons have occupied the ancestral property of Gurudev Rabindra. 3. As soon as results come, Bengal will again become Sonar Bangla There is no encroachment in UP. There, goons know that if they encroach, the government will take out their 7 generations' land and build houses for the poor. I know that on May 4, when the results come, Bengal will recognize its identity by becoming Sonar Bangla. We have to save Bengal's identity. The fundamentalism that is being promoted right now must be stopped at all costs. For this, use the power that India's democracy has given. 4. No Curfew No Riots, All is Well in UP CM Yogi also held a rally at the Chakdaha seat in Nadia district. He said - There is an atmosphere of unrest in Bengal today. Mamata Didi doesn't allow Durga Puja to happen. Curfew is imposed before festivals. The Bengal which gave India its national anthem and national song. TMC goons have occupied the ancestral property of the same Rabindranath Tagore. They have put up photos of Mamata Banerjee and Abhishek Banerjee there. Neither daughters are safe, nor sisters are safe. Neither farmers nor traders are safe. The condition of UP before 2017 was even worse than this. Then the people of UP contributed to forming BJP's double engine government. After that, there has been no riot in UP for 9 years. No curfew, no riots, everything is fine in UP... 5. Anyone who lays hands on a daughter's honor goes to Yamraj's house Yogi said - In UP, if anyone lays hands on the honor of any sister or daughter, they go straight to Yamraj's house. The farmer, the provider, is prosperous, there is a wave of development. The work that was not done in 500 years, under Modi ji's leadership, the construction of Ram Mandir in Ayodhya has been completed. This time a double engine government is going to be formed in Bengal.

stories.title: Stone-pelting between SP leaders and villagers in Ghazipur:Ex-minister injured; clash during visit to murdered girl’s family
stories.summary: In Ghazipur, stones were pelted heavily between the SP delegation and villagers. The SP delegation had arrived to meet a victim's family, but the villagers stopped them outside the village. After an altercation during this, stone pelting occurred. In this, former minister Ram Asare Vishwakarma sustained serious injuries to his head. He has been admitted to the hospital. Actually, on April 15, the body of 16-year-old girl Nisha Vishwakarma was found in the river near Jamania bridge. Police investigation revealed this case to be a murder. After this, one accused was arrested and sent to jail. Since Nisha's death, there has been a tense atmosphere in the village. Meanwhile, on Wednesday, the SP delegation reached Katriya village to meet the victim's family. First see 2 pictures

stories.title: Fighter aircraft show on Purvanchal Expressway:Air Force conducting war exercises in Sultanpur; 5 km area sealed, route diverted
stories.summary: An air show of fighter aircraft is taking place today, i.e., Wednesday, on the Purvanchal Expressway in UP. The roar of Indian Air Force fighter jets can be heard on the airstrip built near Arwal Kiri Karwat village on the Purvanchal Expressway in Sultanpur. Nine fighter jets including Sukhoi, Mirage, Tejas, and Jaguar are performing takeoff and landing demonstrations. A 5-kilometer area has been sealed for the 6-hour air show. The war exercises began at 2 PM on the expressway's airstrip. This will continue until 5 PM. After that, war exercises will be held from 6 PM to 9 PM at night. According to UPDA, i.e., UP Expressway Industrial Development Authority, for the first time, fighter aircraft will fly from east to west direction. Earlier, the air show had taken place from west to east direction. See pictures On Tuesday afternoon, nine fighter aircraft of the Air Force arrived at the airstrip and practiced for about an hour. During this time, hearing the roar of the aircraft, people came out of their homes. The administration says that the air show is not only important from a strategic perspective, but it will also strengthen the region's identity at the national level. Earlier in June 2023, this exercise lasted for 4 hours. On November 16, 2021, PM Modi inaugurated the Purvanchal Expressway from Sultanpur itself. During the program, fighter jets like Sukhoi, Jaguar, and Mirage also performed stunts in the sky over the airstrip for about an hour. PM Modi himself landed on the airstrip in an Air Force Hercules aircraft. The 341 km long Purvanchal Expressway built from Lucknow to Ghazipur costs Rs 22,494.66 crore. Its construction started in October 2018 and was completed in September 2021.

stories.title: Girl drowns in bathtub in Lucknow:Mother faints repeatedly; father recalls her sweet daily goodbye
stories.summary: 'Wherever I went, my little girl would come to the door to see me off. She would push the bike with her tiny hands. When I returned, she would come to the road to receive me. I never came back from outside without bringing something for her...but now who will come to receive me...I don't understand what I will do now.' Saying this, Sonu's voice chokes up. His eyes well up with tears. Sonu lives with his family in Garha village in Nagram, Lucknow. He has two daughters. His younger daughter Tanya (1 year 9 months) died a tragic death on April 19 after drowning in a tub at home. Since then, he has been silent. Dainik Bhaskar reporters reached Sonu's house. Everyone there was crying, remembering Tanya. Some were family members and some were neighbors. For 3 days, mother Lalita has been fainting while remembering her daughter. Women sprinkle water on her, then she regains consciousness. Then she calls out to her daughter and becomes unconscious again. Even in sleep, she keeps saying Tanya...Tanya. Grandmother was stretching out her hands in front of people coming to the house, asking for her granddaughter. She was just saying that someone please return my granddaughter to me. First see 3 pictures of the house 'Couldn't understand how she reached the tub' Tanya's father Sonu recalls that day - At the time of the accident, everyone was present at home. Grandfather had to go to Mohanlalganj. He asked for tea to be made. The wife had filled water in the tub for bathing, but got busy making tea. I was outside the house. Grandfather was in the TV room. About 10 minutes later when the tea was ready, Sonu called both his children to have tea, who were playing at the neighbor's house. The children came inside to have tea. Sonu said - He couldn't understand when and how Tanya reached the bathroom and fell into the water-filled tub. When mother and wife brought Tanya out, they came to know that the child had already died. Anya kept searching for her younger sister all day Sonu told that three-year-old elder daughter Anya kept searching for her younger sister Tanya in the house all day. She kept asking her mother and family members again and again where Tanya was. Helpless family members explained to the innocent child that Tanya has gone to her grandmother's house. House immersed in mourning, stove not lit Since the accident, the stove has not been lit in Tanya's house. The family members are in such shock that no one has felt like cooking or eating. Neighbors and relatives are bringing food for the family, but the household members are barely able to eat a few morsels. Mother Lalita's condition is terrible from crying. Meanwhile, grandmother Kusumavati keeps losing consciousness repeatedly. There is silence everywhere in the house, where Tanya's voice once echoed, now there are only sobs. Daughter fell into water tub while playing

stories.title: Mayor faces heat over remark on Akhilesh’s mother:BJP Mahila Morcha VP protests; SP workers hit nameplate with slippers
stories.summary: The controversy over Mayor Sushma Kharkwal's statement during BJP's Janaakrosh rally in Lucknow on Tuesday regarding the Women's Reservation Bill continues to escalate. Now leaders from her own party are questioning her statement. BJP Mahila Morcha State Vice President Asmita Chand said - The dignity of language and respect for departed souls should be maintained. Meanwhile, SP has taken to the streets against Sushma Kharkwal. SP leaders pelted her nameplate with slippers. They smeared it with black ink. They shook the barricades installed for security. They raised slogans of 'Murdabad' (down with). They posted a video of this on social media. Actually, Sushma Kharkwal had taken a jibe at SP President Akhilesh Yadav saying that Akhilesh has insulted the mother who gave birth to him. Akhilesh had expressed his displeasure over this. He had also written a public letter to Sushma Kharkwal. Mayor Sushma Kharkwal has also given a clarification in the matter. She said- Why would I abuse someone's mother? Let it be shown anywhere that I have abused. Akhilesh demanded reservation for Muslim women. When the country was divided on the basis of religion, go and demand this reservation in Pakistan. I had raised the issue of half the population. First let's understand the entire matter... Now let's read Akhilesh's counterattack Asmita Chand said- We have to oppose policies, not memories BJP Mahila Morcha's State Vice President Asmita Chand posted on social media on Tuesday. She wrote - In politics we fight over ideology and policies, but our values teach us that the place of motherhood is above all. The context in which Lucknow Mayor Sushma Kharkwal has mentioned Akhilesh Yadav's late mother does not align with our BJP's culture, where we consider respect for women as our supreme duty. She wrote - Making sarcastic remarks about the womb and birth of someone who is not in this world during the discussion on a glorious subject like the Women's Reservation Bill is not in accordance with our moral standards. As a member of the BJP family, we are proud that our party is empowering women through initiatives like Nari Shakti Vandan. However, in this journey of empowerment, the dignity of language and respect for departed souls should be maintained. He said - Political rivalry has its place. However, for any son, memories of his mother are always sacred. Ultimately, our words define our personality and party values. We must oppose policies, not memories. Asmita is the daughter-in-law of Markandey Chand Asmita Chand is the daughter-in-law of Markandey Chand, who was a former minister and a prominent leader of Purvanchal. Asmita's brother-in-law CP Chand is a BJP MLC. Asmita contested elections as an independent in 2007. Due to being from a political family, after joining BJP, she was directly made the state vice president of the women's wing. According to sources, Asmita has not been active in the organization for the past few months. In such a situation, her post against the mayor has strengthened speculations of her joining SP. State Vice President Women's Wing Asmita Chand said- I have posted what I wanted to say on social media, I have no intention of contesting elections from SP, Vinay Shankar Tiwari ji from SP is there. Had claimed candidacy from Chillupar Asmita Chand had demanded a ticket from the Chillupar assembly seat in Gorakhpur district in 2022. However, BJP made Rajesh Tripathi the candidate from Chillupar. Rajesh had defeated Hari Shankar Tiwari's son Vinay Shankar Tiwari in the 2022 elections. Due to Rajesh Tripathi's strong hold in the area, his ticket is considered certain in 2027 as well. Discussions started in BJP that Asmita Chand is preparing to contest elections from SP in 2027. That's why she made this post in support of Akhilesh Yadav, deviating from the party line.

stories.title: Haj pilgrims sent off with saffron flag in Lucknow:India using AI technology to track pilgrims
stories.summary: The first batch of Haj pilgrims departed on Wednesday from the Mohammad Ali Mian Haj Committee of India Haj House located in Sarojininagar. It includes 427 Haj pilgrims. Minority Welfare State Minister Danish Azad and religious leaders flagged off the bus carrying Haj pilgrims to Chaudhary Charan Singh International Airport by showing green and saffron flags. On this occasion, Danish said that for the first time, India is using AI in Haj. In case of any inconvenience, Haj pilgrims can be tracked. They can be provided immediate relief. He said that the government's effort is to provide better facilities to Haj pilgrims. This year, due to the heat, complete health arrangements have been made from Lucknow Haj House to Mecca-Medina. In connection with Haj preparations, a delegation of Uttar Pradesh Haj Committee had also gone to Saudi Arabia. It has returned after inspecting all the facilities there. See 4 pictures related to the departure of Hajj pilgrims Flight will take off at 2:20 PM The Hajj pilgrims' flight will take off at 2:20 PM. Family members of the Hajj pilgrims also reached the Hajj House to bid them farewell. Children and relatives of many Hajj pilgrims broke down crying while seeing them off. Former SP MLA from Kanpur, Irfan Solanki, came to bid farewell to his four brothers who were leaving for Hajj. He said that his passport is blocked (suspended). Due to this reason, he is unable to go for Hajj. He told his brothers to pray in Mecca that his passport gets restored and he too can go for Hajj.

stories.title: UP Board Class 10, 12 results tomorrow:To be declared at 4 pm, over 5 million students appeared
stories.summary: UP Board Class 10 and 12 results will be declared tomorrow, April 23. Students can check their results on the official website. UP Board Secretary Bhagwati Singh said the results will be released at 4 pm on Thursday. Last year, the results were announced on April 25. This time, they are being declared two days earlier. He stated- Along with the release of UP Board results, the list of toppers for 10th and 12th will also be released. The students who achieve top positions across the state will be honored by the state government. Check results like this> Over 50 lakh students appeared for the exam According to the Uttar Pradesh Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad, a total of 52,30,297 students registered for the Class 10 and 12 board exams in 2026. In High School (Class 10), 27,50,945 students registered, including 14,38,682 boys and 13,12,263 girls. In Intermediate (Class 12), 24,79,352 students registered. The examinations were conducted across all 75 districts at 8,033 centres from February 18. Exams were held in two shifts and concluded on March 12. A total of 2.87 lakh students dropped out, including 1.61 lakh from High School and 1.26 lakh from Intermediate. 254 evaluation centres set up, marking completed by April 4 A total of 254 evaluation centres were set up across the state. As many as 1,52,780 teachers were appointed for checking answer sheets, including 96,804 for High School and 55,976 for Intermediate. The evaluation process began on March 18 and continued till April 4. This year, around 2.80 crore answer sheets were evaluated, including nearly 1.57 crore for High School and 1.23 crore for Intermediate. Failed students can also pass Marksheet will be available on DigiLocker This will be the second time that marksheets will be made available on DigiLocker after the result declaration. Hard copies will later be provided through schools as usual. How was the 2025 result? Yash from Jalaun topped in 10th In the 2025 results, Yash from Jalaun topped Class 10 with 97.83%. Anshi from Etawah and Abhishek from Barabanki secured second place with 97.67%. Ritu Garg from Moradabad, Arpit Verma from Sitapur and Simran Gupta from Jalaun secured third place with 97.50%. Among districts, Agra topped with a pass percentage of 94.99%, followed by Basti (94.67%) and Mathura (94.60%). Sonbhadra had the lowest pass percentage at 74.72%. Girls dominated Class 12 results In Class 12, girls outperformed boys. Mehak Jaiswal from Prayagraj topped the state with 97.20%. Her father is a daily wage labourer. Sakshi from Amroha, Adarsh Yadav from Sultanpur, Shivani Singh from Prayagraj and Anushka Singh from Kaushambi secured second position with 96.80%. Mohini from Etawah secured third place with 96.40%. Overall, five girls and one boy featured in the top three ranks. Girls recorded a pass percentage 10% higher than boys. Amethi had the highest pass percentage at 92.65%, while Chandauli recorded the lowest at 65.70%.

stories.title: Haryanvi actress Divyanka Sirohi passes away:Suffers heart attack at home in UP; worked in over 50 songs
stories.summary: Haryanvi actress Divyanka Sirohi (30) has passed away. Reports say she suffered a heart attack at her home late Tuesday night. She suddenly collapsed and fell, sustaining a deep head injury with bleeding. Family members rushed her to a hospital, where doctors declared her dead. Her final rites were performed on Wednesday morning in Ghaziabad. People associated with the Haryanvi industry, including producers and artists from Haryana, reached her home to pay their last respects. The industry has expressed deep grief over her demise, though no official statement has been issued by her family so far. Divyanka was originally from Uttar Pradesh and was born on 19 November 1996 in Bulandshahr. She had worked in more than 50 Haryanvi songs and collaborated with several artists, including singer Masoom Sharma, Amit Saini Rohtakiya, and KD. She had a strong presence on social media with around 1.3 million followers on Instagram. She had studied B.Com from Chaudhary Charan Singh University in Meerut, followed by an MBA from Sikkim and later a B.Ed from Gurugram. She was currently living in Ghaziabad with her parents and grandmother. Her father is a transporter and her mother is a homemaker. Family living in Ghaziabad Family members said she was at home on Tuesday evening when her condition suddenly worsened around 8 pm. She fell unconscious, and by the time her younger brother Deepanshu reached her, her body had already turned cold. She was taken to hospital, where doctors confirmed her death. The family has not issued any statement yet. Began on TikTok, Got 20 Million Views Divyanka began her journey in the entertainment industry through TikTok, where she gained massive popularity. In an interview, she had shared that she had a passion for acting and dancing since childhood. One of her early TikTok videos, made during Diwali on Punjabi singer Sunanda Sharma’s song “Meri Mammi Nu Pasand Ni Tu,” went viral due to her expressions and received around 20 million views, after which her followers grew to nearly 5 million. She entered the Haryanvi music industry in 2018 after leaving her job. Artists from the Haryanvi industry continue to mourn her sudden demise.

stories.title: Monkey sits holding newborn baby for 2 hours in Muzaffarnagar:Attempts to bite family members trying to save the child | VIDEO
stories.summary: In Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh, a monkey sat inside a house holding a 3-month-old baby for two hours. The baby was lying on a bed inside the room. The family members were busy with their own work. During this time, a monkey quietly entered the room and sat near the baby. The monkey began to caress the child, stroking him, and playing with him. After a while, when the family members returned from work and entered the room, they were startled by fear. This made the monkey aggressive. It began to run towards the family members, trying to bite them. During this, the child started crying. The family tried everything to scare the monkey away. They offered it food and threatened it with a stick, but the monkey wouldn't budge. It remained sitting near the child. The child continued to cry, frightening the family. However, the monkey didn't harm the child. It simply sat there, holding him. Later, the family contacted an animal rescuer. The rescuer approached the monkey and distracted it by showing wildlife videos on his mobile phone. As soon as the monkey moved toward the mobile phone, the rescuer pulled the child closer. The incident occurred on Tuesday, the video of which surfaced on Wednesday. The incident occurred in Charathawal town, 15 km from the district headquarters. Monkey's baby had died 6 days ago, mistook human child as her own Animal rescuer Sunny Chopra said, ‘After trying everything they could to distract the monkey, they started watching wildlife videos on their mobile phones. They played videos of baby monkeys. As soon as the monkey became engrossed in watching the videos, they gently pulled the baby from its clutches. After this, the people chased the monkey away.’ Chopra said, ‘She was a female monkey. Her baby had died 6 days ago. That is why when she saw the 3-month-old baby, she started mistaking him for her own child. She sat near him. When she felt that people were separating her from her baby, she became aggressive. Otherwise, she did not hurt the baby even once. At present, the baby has been rescued. The baby is completely safe.’

stories.title: Transgender devotee builds grand Shiva temple in Gorakhpur:Prema invests lifetime earnings of ₹85 lakh, Pran-Pratishtha ceremony set for April 24
stories.summary: In Gorakhpur’s Padri Bazaar area, under Jungle Matadin locality, a remarkable story of devotion and determination has taken shape. Transgender Prema has built a grand Shiva temple, using money earned through years of hard work and blessings received during social engagements. The initiative stands out as a rare blend of personal faith and public service. Temple ready, Pran-Pratishtha on April 24 The temple, named Vishweshwar Nath Temple, has been constructed at an estimated cost of around Rs 85 lakh. It is not dedicated to any particular group but has been opened to the entire society. The Pran Pratishtha ceremony is scheduled for April 24, when elaborate religious rituals will mark the formal consecration of the shrine. A lifetime’s wish fulfilled Prema, who has been living in the area with disciples for nearly six decades, says the temple is the culmination of a long-cherished dream. Reflecting on her journey, she said she had spent her life earning, sustaining herself, and contributing to society, and wanted to leave behind a spiritual legacy by building a temple of Lord Shiva. Key highlights of the initiative * Temple constructed with personal savings and community blessings * Estimated project cost stands at around Rs 85 lakh * Dedicated to the entire community, not a single group * Consecration ceremony to be held with full religious rituals Preparations gather pace for grand ceremony The upcoming consecration ceremony is expected to draw devotees, local residents, and several dignitaries. Kundan Upadhyay will lead the rituals as the chief patron of the event. Preparations are in full swing, with efforts focused on decorating the temple premises and ensuring a smooth आयोजन of the programme. Social service remains central to journey * Helped construct a public road for local residents * Provided financial support for marriages of three girls from poor families * Long-standing engagement in community welfare activities * Earned recognition for consistent grassroots contributions A legacy beyond devotion Prema’s work extends beyond the temple, reflecting a sustained commitment to social causes. From improving local infrastructure to supporting underprivileged families, her efforts have left a tangible impact on the community. With the temple now complete, residents see it not just as a place of worship, but as a symbol of inclusive faith and service.

stories.title: Rinku Singh prays for IPL trophy at Kashi Vishwanath Temple:Joins Ganga aarti; set to marry MP Priya Saroj in June
stories.summary: Kolkata Knight Riders' vice-captain Rinku Singh has embarked on a religious journey. He performed special prayers at the Kashi Vishwanath Temple for his team's victory. He stayed at the temple for half an hour, during which he was accompanied by his fiance Priya Saroj and his teammate, Kolkata Knight Riders' all-rounder Anukul Roy. During the Ganga Aarti, before the ritual begins, the priest administered a pledge, during which he said that he wants his team to be the winner in this year's IPL. Not only this, he sat among the devotees and watched the 45-minute Ganga Aarti with great devotion. Someone close to him revealed that when he was leaving after the darshan, he said that he has received everything, and his only wish from Baba is to win the IPL trophy this time. Now he will go to Ayodhya and have darshan of Lord Ramlala in the evening. Inspected wedding arrangements at Taj Hotel Upon arriving in Kashi, Rinku Singh first reached Priya Saroj's house where her father, Kerat MLA and former MP Toofani Saroj, welcomed him with a bouquet along with family members. Special food arrangements were made for Rinku Singh. After which he headed straight to the Taj Hotel. It is being said that the wedding may take place at Varanasi's Taj Hotel in the first week of June, although the date has not been announced yet. However, Rinku Singh viewed the wedding packages at the Taj Hotel and also met with various social workers of Varanasi and leaders of the Samajwadi Party. Rinku Singh is playing for KKR in IPL Playing for Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR), he delivered victory in Sunday's match in IPL 2026. In the Kolkata-Rajasthan match, he scored an unbeaten 53 runs off 34 balls. He also led the team to a 4-wicket victory. The team's next match is on April 26. Now read the story of Rinku Singh's struggle Seeing his father work hard, Rinku would get worried. Behind Rinku Singh's success lies his father's hard struggle. Khanchand worked as a hawker at a gas agency in Aligarh. For the good upbringing of his 5 sons and daughter, he delivered cylinders door-to-door for many years. First, he used to deliver on a bicycle, then he started delivering cylinders to people's homes by tempo. In childhood, Rinku would get worried seeing his father work so hard. He had promised that Papa...one day I will become your support and free you from this hard work. As soon as he became successful in cricket, Rinku also fulfilled his promise to his father. His mother Veena Devi manages the household responsibilities. Rinku is the fourth among 5 brothers and one sister. The elder brothers are Sonu, Mukul and Sheelu. While sister Neha and brother Jeetu are younger than Rinku. His family once lived in Dangarh, Bulandshahr, which later shifted to Aligarh. Rinku and Priya Saroj are already engaged Rinku and SP MP Priya Saroj are already engaged. Both are going to marry in June, 2026 this year. Last year, Rinku and Priya's ring ceremony took place in Lucknow. Sources say that after the father's demise, the family may reconsider the date of Rinku's wedding. Wedding date has been postponed twice Before this, Rinku-Priya's wedding date has been postponed twice. The first date was set for November 18, 2025, but it was postponed due to a cricket series. The second date came up in February 2026, but it had to be cancelled due to the World Cup. Rinku's elder brother Sonu Singh had informed that the wedding bells will ring only when Rinku is free from IPL. The wedding will take place in Kashi. The reception will be held in Aligarh.

stories.title: 'Lenskart owner is descendant of Aurangzeb':BJP MLA Nand Kishore reaches store in Ghaziabad, opposes dress code policy
stories.summary: BJP MLA from Loni, Nandkishor Gurjar, reached a Lenskart showroom in Ghaziabad on Tuesday evening. He spoke with the employees working there and expressed opposition to the dress code. MLA Nandkishor Gurjar said, 'This is a very wrong decision. Living in India and not being able to wear bindi and kalava, this is not appropriate. Even though the company owner's name is Piyush, either his mother or father must be Muslim. He is the descendant of Aurangzeb. This should be investigated.' Action should be taken under NSA At the showroom, MLA Nandkishore Gurjar said, ‘The owner of Lenskart should be investigated. There is a majority population in Hindustan and he is posing as a fake Hindu. The way he has permitted burqa and hijab and banned tilak and kalawa, this decision is wrong. This is a very serious matter. The kind of order he has issued, action should be taken against him under NSA.’ 'This is the century of Sanatan. The country's Prime Minister Narendra Modi has hoisted India's flag across the entire world. Our Prime Minister Narendra Modi wears kalawa and tilak and raises the slogan 'Har-Har Mahadev' before the world. The thinking of Lenskart's owner Peyush Bansal is one of appeasement.' 'This is not Muslim, this is jihadi Muslim. His name may be Peyush, but either his mother or father must be Muslim. He should be investigated. There will be protests against this across the entire country.' Government should take over this company He further said that the government should take over this company. FIRs have been filed against Piyush Bansal at several places. Action will definitely be taken. This is the century of Hindus. Sanatanis will never adopt this company. What is the reason for the controversy? Actually, Lenskart, a company dealing in eyewear business, has been embroiled in controversies over its dress code. An alleged policy document of the company has gone viral on social media. In this, employees have been prohibited from wearing bindi, tilak and kalava, while hijab and turban have been allowed with conditions. The controversy escalated when activist Shefali Vaidya shared a screenshot of it on X. She asked the company's founder - Peyush Bansal, can you clarify why hijab is okay at Lenskart but not bindi and kalawa? Following this, people trolled Lenskart and questioned the company's policy. What is written in the viral document? According to this 'grooming guide' shared on social media, female employees are not allowed to wear bindi or clutcher in the store. Additionally, instructions have been given to remove religious threads (kalawa) or wrist bands worn on the hand. Meanwhile, the same document states that if an employee wears a hijab or turban, it should be black in color. The length of the hijab should be such that it does not hide the company logo. However, wearing a burqa to work in the store has been prohibited. Company earned profit of Rs 131 crore in December quarter Lenskart's profit increased nearly 70 times in the December quarter. The company's net profit has increased from 1.85 crore rupees a year ago to 131 crore rupees (1.31 billion) now. Piyush Bansal said, ‘Viral document is old and incorrect’ Piyush Bansal called the viral document old and incorrect. He said that it does not reflect the company's current guidelines. The company respects all religions. We have thousands of team members in the country who proudly wear their faith and culture every day.

stories.title: Man impersonating cop in Bareilly arrested:Passed obscene comments on women dancing at wedding procession; limps out of police station begging for forgiveness
stories.summary: Police arrested Hasan Khan on Tuesday in Bareilly for making objectionable comments about women. After the arrest, the accused came out of the police station limping. He was seen crying and apologizing. The accused pleaded saying, ‘Forgive me, a very big mistake has been made. I will never do such a thing again.’ A video of the accused pleading has also surfaced, in which he is seen apologizing with folded hands. Actually, on April 20 (Monday), Hasan Khan had uploaded a video on his Instagram. In the video, he is sitting in a car. Women are dancing on the road. He says, ‘Look at this, they are dancing like witches dance, damn it, they have made life hell. Many users had objected to this. After this, the police arrested the accused within 12 hours.’ Police investigation has revealed that the accused used to show off by posing as a fake policeman. He has posted several such videos on his Instagram account in which he is wearing a police uniform. In some videos, he is seen driving a vehicle behind a police jeep. See pictures Now read what Hasan Khan said in the video? 'Look, is there any shortage in wedding processions' In the video that Hasan Khan uploaded, he was going somewhere in a car. During this time, a wedding procession was passing on his way. Women were dancing to DJ and band music on the road. On this, Hasan said, ‘Look, is there any shortage in wedding processions. What can I say, sometimes we get stuck in such places, it becomes difficult to get out.’ 'The wretched woman makes life hell' Going a little further ahead, some policemen were seen standing at the crossroads. At this, he said, ‘These are our Daroga ji standing here. After this, he told the policeman, ’They dance like witches, the wretched ones make our life hell.' Accused arrested within 12 hours After the matter came to light, Hindu organizations protested. Following this, the police registered an FIR based on the video. Within about 12 hours, Hasan was arrested. In the arrest video, Hasan apologized with folded hands before the police. Confessing his crime, he revealed that he had bought a police jacket from a shop near Chaupla. In a show-off attempt, he wore it and posted a photo. Hasan Khan used to attend peace meetings According to police, Hasan Khan son of Gulfam is a resident of Kanjadaspur in Izzatnagar police station area. Hasan used to show off by claiming to be a policeman. He used to wear uniform and threaten people in his area. Hasan was quite active on social media. He used to make reels and upload videos. He appeared with police personnel in several videos. In one video, he also made a reel wearing police uniform. Surprisingly, it also came to light that the accused used to attend peace committee meetings. Case Filed and Accused Sent to Jail Izzatnagar police station has registered a case against accused Hasan under sections 79 and 205 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). The police have also initiated the process to recover the jacket that he was wearing while impersonating a fake police officer. Izzatnagar police station in-charge Pankaj Srivastava said, The accused has been arrested. Further action is being taken in the case.

stories.title: Canadian citizen's body found lying in filth in Manikarnika Ghat:Kashi man performs his last rites; wife watches on video call
stories.summary: The Canadian citizen Taras Tanasov (55 years old), who was found sick at Varanasi ghat by Aman Kabir trust has died. His last rites were performed at Manikarnika Ghat in presence of other foreigners and his wife, who attended the cremation on a video call. On 12 April, social worker Aman Kabir admitted Taras to Kabirchowra Hospital after receiving information that he was lying in filth at the ghat. After his death, his wife could not reach India. She sent a letter through the embassy to Aman Kabir for the last rites. During this time, his wife Ellen watched her husband's final journey live and bid farewell with moist eyes. Foreign citizens were also present at the ghat during this time. Taras was found ill at the ghat Aman Yadav of Aman Kabir Trust said - 10 days ago, a foreign national was found at Manikarnika Ghat. The people there and Monu Baba had informed me about this. And they said that he was sick. When I reached there, I saw he was living in filth. His body had become weak. In this situation, he was bathed, cleaned up and admitted to Kabirchora Hospital. Death occurred on 15 April, two passports were found with Taras Aman said - During treatment at Kabirchora Hospital, Taras died on the morning of 15 April. The doctor said that he had diabetes. He died due to the illness. The body was kept in the mortuary and the police and the Local Intelligence Unit (LIU) were informed. Two passports have been found with Taras. One is from the European country Republic of Moldova and one is from Canada. When LIU contacted both embassies, it was found that Taras was a resident of Republic of Moldova and his wife is from Canada. That's why he held two passports. Secret revealed when wife Ellen was contacted Aman said - When LIU contacted wife Ellen in Canada, the secret of Taras coming to India and Kashi was revealed. According to the information given by Ellen, Taras has two wives. He also has diabetes. Seven months ago, he came to Kashi for moksha (salvation) after being upset with his wives. Here he stayed in a room for 4 months for 3500 rupees. After that he started living near the ghat. During this time he became very ill. Cremation took place after Canadian Embassy gave permission Aman Kabir informed - After this, with the help of LIU and local administration, the Canadian Embassy spoke with the family members and gave permission to Aman Kabir Trust for the last rites according to Hindu customs. Following this, after conducting the post-mortem of the body on the evening of 21 April, cremation was performed at Manikarnika Ghat. Wife Ellen witnessed the funeral procession, foreigners participated After 5 pm on Tuesday, 21 April, Taras's funeral procession departed from Kabirchowra Hospital to Manikarnika Ghat with Hindu rituals. During this time, Taras's wife Ellen watched the funeral procession with moist eyes. When Taras's funeral procession reached Manikarnika Ghat, foreigners paid their last respects to Taras and joined the funeral procession.

stories.title: Union Minister Shivraj stuck in Lucknow traffic jam:Leaves without attending wedding of senior BJP leader's daughter
stories.summary: Lucknow's traffic system has once again caused embarrassment. Union Agriculture Minister and former Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh Shivraj Singh Chouhan got stuck in a traffic jam in the capital on Monday. He had to return without attending the wedding ceremony he had arrived for. BJP MLC and BJP in-charge of Madhya Pradesh Mahendra Singh's daughter's wedding was on Monday at Janeshwar Mishra Park. In another section of Janeshwar Mishra Park itself, the wedding of state government minister Dinesh Pratap Singh's niece was also taking place. To attend the weddings at the homes of two senior leaders, CM Yogi Adityanath, Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya, Deputy CM Brajesh Pathak, several ministers of the central government, national and state office bearers of BJP, ministers of the state government, several senior office bearers of RSS, MLAs, MPs and officials had arrived. Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan also came to the wedding ceremony to bless the bride and groom. State government PWD Minister of State Brajesh Singh was assigned to Shivraj's protocol. Brajesh Singh reached Janeshwar Mishra Park with Shivraj Singh. Shivraj Singh attended the wedding of Dinesh Pratap Singh's niece and blessed the bride and groom and also gave them a gift. But ahead of that, his convoy got stuck in a traffic jam. Even after considerable effort, the jam did not clear, and due to being stuck in the jam, there was a possibility of Shivraj Singh missing his flight. Due to the heavy traffic jam, Shivraj Singh Chouhan handed over his gift to Brajesh Singh in an annoyed tone. He returned without attending the wedding ceremony. Brajesh Singh reached the stage and informed Mahendra Singh about this, and also presented the gift given by Shivraj Singh. Minister of State for PWD Brajesh Singh said, Shivraj Singh Chouhan arrived a little late. Many VVIPs were attending the wedding at Janeshwar Mishra Park. The VVIP fleet was overwhelmed. The private plane Shivraj flew in had an FLT until 9:30 pm. Therefore, he had to return without attending Mahendra Singh's wedding.

stories.title: Nuclear Medicine doctor at Lucknow cancer institute resigns:28 doctors leave in 5 years; complaints of low salaries
stories.summary: Kalyan Singh Super Speciality Cancer Institute has suffered another setback. Dr. Sonam Suman from the Nuclear Medicine Department of the institute has resigned. However, the clear reason for leaving the institute has not been mentioned in the resignation. Officials say that despite being a super speciality institute, the salary being given is that of a State Medical College. Whereas some doctors in the institute are being paid salaries equivalent to KGMU, PGI. The resignation of the woman doctor has dealt a blow to the operation of PET CT and other machines in the Nuclear Medicine Department. 400 patients are coming to the OPD of the Cancer Institute daily. There are approximately 300 beds. Most beds remain occupied all the time. 40 to 50 patients are being admitted daily in the emergency. Due to salary discrepancies and other mismanagement, 28 specialist doctors have left their jobs in the past five years. More than 60 nursing staff and about a dozen technicians and employees have bid farewell to the Cancer Institute. Not even a single doctor in these departments The institute does not have a single doctor in four departments. These include important departments such as Radio Diagnosis, Medical Oncology, Plastic Surgery, and Nuclear Medicine. Cancer patients are suffering the consequences of this. Patients are unable to get tests related to the Nuclear Medicine department done. Patients have to travel a distance of 20 to 25 kilometers. One Institute, Two Pay Scales Two types of pay scales are being provided to doctors at the Cancer Institute. About 24 doctors are being provided salary and allowances similar to SGPGI and KGMU. The remaining 10 doctors are being provided salary and allowances similar to State Medical College. Nursing, paramedical, and other category employees are being provided salaries similar to State Medical College. This has caused resentment among doctors and employees.

stories.title: Fine on beard and long hair at Lucknow's Lohia Institute:₹2,000 fine for taking leave without informing; ₹500 fine for sleeping or smoking
stories.summary: A major controversy has erupted over new rules issued for outsourced employees at Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Institute of Medical Sciences in Lucknow. According to the order issued by the agency, male employees will be fined Rs 200 for keeping a beard or long hair. Female employees will also have to pay a fine of Rs 200 for not keeping their hair in a bun or the prescribed hairstyle. Outsourcing Company Issues Order It is being reported that around 4000 outsourced employees are working in the institute. The agency's camp manager has issued this order on the instructions of the institute administration. Under this, a fine of Rs 100 has been fixed for not wearing an ID card or nameplate during duty and Rs 200 per day for not wearing the prescribed uniform. A fine of 500 rupees will be imposed for being absent from duty without notice or leaving the workplace. A penalty of up to 2000 rupees may have to be paid for taking leave or remaining absent without prior notice. A fine of 500 rupees has also been fixed for being found sleeping, smoking, or consuming alcohol during duty. The order also states that in cases of corrupt conduct, use of improper methods, or collusion with officials, an FIR will be filed along with termination of service if found guilty. Employees allege that such strict and unusual rules are not implemented in other institutions of the state. They have expressed opposition, calling this order impractical. The system will not apply to regular employees According to the aggrieved outsourcing employees, outsourcing companies are working on the instructions of the institution administration. Such orders have been issued to put pressure on outsourcing employees, whereas this order is not being applied to regular employees deployed in the institution, whose number is approximately 1000.

stories.title: 'We will conduct Rath Yatra for Hindu Rashtra':Dhirendra Shastri's Hanumant Katha in Prayagraj; says, 'Lenskart should open store in Lahore'
stories.summary: Today is the second day of Pandit Dhirendra Krishna Shastri, the Peethadhishwar of Bageshwar Dham's Hanumant Katha in Prayagraj. On the first day, he said that, ‘India will become a Hindu nation. Efforts are ongoing for that. Regarding the resolve for a Hindu nation, we will conduct a chariot procession this year. We will make the announcement on July 4th and provide complete information about the chariot procession.’ He said, ‘Those who have a problem with tilak, chandan, worship, Ram, Shyam, Hanuman, Baba Bageshwar, should quietly slip away to Lahore through the narrow lane. Reform yourselves, otherwise Indian law will reform you. UP police is famous anyway. Vehicles do get overturned.’ It's very hot here, from today the Katha will start at 5 o'clock Dhirendra Shastri said, 'The world's biggest Mahakumbh was held in Prayag. This is the land of Sanatan. Whatever you may be at your homes, but keep this thought in your hearts - we are Hindus, we are Sanatani. We have chosen Sundar Kand. We will narrate the Katha for three days.' 'It's very hot here, it's difficult for you to come during the day. That's why we decided to start the Katha at 4-5 o'clock. Otherwise, you might come to listen to the Katha and attain moksha, it's very difficult brother.' Gave reply to Bareilly's Maulana Shastri said, ‘One day, Rudra Abhishek will definitely be performed at Gyanvapi. The stain that exists next to Kashi Vishwanath Ji will be removed. We want crowds in temples, storms on the streets. We want a Hindustan filled with Ram Rajya. I have complete faith in the judiciary.’ On the question of opposition from a Maulana in Bareilly, Dhirendra Shastri said, 'It's a game of time. People worth two paise start selling for crores.' One day the saffron flag will also fly over Gyanvapi Dhirendra Shastri said that just as the Ram Temple was built, similarly one day the saffron flag will also fly over Gyanvapi. He reached Bamrauli Airport by helicopter on Tuesday afternoon. From here he traveled by car to Karela Bagh, then by steamer in the Yamuna to Arail Selfie Point. Upon his arrival, devotees raised slogans hailing Bageshwar Baba. Shastri said, ‘Lenskart should open a company in Lahore’ Dhirendra Shastri said, 'Lenskart company has imposed a ban on its workers that no one can come wearing a tilak. Cannot come wearing a mangalsutra, wearing sindoor. You open your company in Lahore. Why are you dying in India. Is India your uncle's? Yes, India is our father's.' 'Those who have a problem with tilak, chandan, vandan, Ram, Shyam, Hanuman, Baba Bageshwar, should slip away to Lahore through a narrow lane. We will also tell the Lenskart people, you have gone wrong. Correct yourself, otherwise Indian law also corrects.' 'I say to Hindus, today they have pointed fingers at your mangalsutra and tilak. If we Hindus do not unite, tomorrow they will point fingers at your community, Sanatan and children. Tomorrow they will also point fingers at our Gita and Ramayana.' However, two days ago, eyewear retailer company Lenskart publicly apologized after heavy opposition on social media. Apart from this, they have now issued a new and transparent 'in-store style guide', which gives employees complete permission to wear their religious and cultural symbols at the workplace. 13,000 square feet pandal on Yamuna banks A grand pandal has been constructed in 13 thousand square meters at the Katha venue located on the Yamuna riverbank. The Katha which started today on April 21 will conclude on April 23. On the first day, around 20-22 thousand devotees reached the pandal. Arrangements for the Katha have been made in an area of approximately six acres. 8 entry gates have been constructed in the pandal for devotees to enter and exit. 3000 police personnel, 500 CCTVs and drones have been deployed for surveillance. Amidst the huge crowd that came to listen to Dhirendra Shastri's Katha, one devotee arrived in a wheelchair. BJP Leader Organized the Katha Event The host of the Hanumant Katha is BJP leader Dr. Uday Pratap Singh, a resident of Prayagraj. He is the Director of Harinarayan Group of Colleges. He has a total of five colleges. Apart from this, he owns a rice mill. His father had a factory in Mirpur. Later, Uday Pratap started doing property business. Dr. Uday Pratap Singh has met Home Minister Amit Shah several times. He is also close to Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya. He has organized many events before this as well. These have included Bollywood actress and MP Kangana Ranaut, cricketer Suresh Raina, Bhojpuri actress Akshara Singh, singer Hansraj Raghuwanshi, and many other film artists. 6400 Square Feet Grand Stage, VVIP Gallery in Front For the katha (religious discourse), a stage approximately 100 feet long and 64 feet wide, totaling 6400 square feet, has been constructed. Behind the stage, there are 4 VVIP rooms. In front of the stage, a VVIP gallery of approximately 3000 square feet has been built where sofas have been placed. Here, seating arrangements have been made for more than 200 VVIPs. Behind this, chairs have been arranged for 500 VIPs. LED Screens, 250 Fans and VVIP Rooms in the Pandal To give devotees the experience of the katha from every corner, 8 large LED screens have been installed in the middle and back area of the pandal. More than 250 fans have been installed to provide relief from the heat. 3000 Police Personnel, 8 ASPs and 21 DSPs Deployed Around 3000 police personnel will be deployed during the Hanumant Katha. This will include 8 Additional SPs and 21 Deputy SP level officers. The entire event venue has been divided into 8 zones and 21 sectors. Additionally, 10 fire tenders and fire brigade teams will also be present. Additional police force has also been called from nearby districts. Reserve force will be deployed for emergency situations. During the Hanumant Katha, around 500 CCTV cameras will keep watch at every corner. 24-hour surveillance will be maintained through master screens from the control room. 50-bed hospital and community kitchen for 40 thousand people daily During the Katha, there will be special focus on crowd management. Considering the severe heat, a temporary 50-bed hospital has been set up. Doctors and health workers will be deployed there. During the Katha, Bhandara (community meal) is being prepared for 40 thousand people daily, which will be distributed in different pandals. 8 Parking Areas, 350 Traffic Police Personnel Deployed To maintain smooth traffic arrangements during the Katha, eight parking locations have been created. Devotees will park their vehicles in these parking areas and then will have to walk to the main event venue. For traffic management, approximately 350 traffic police personnel have been deployed on duty, who have been on alert since Tuesday morning.
