stories.title: Groom collapses unconscious on wedding stage in Hapur:Bride cries saying, 'He was intoxicated, my life is ruined'
stories.summary: In Hapur on Saturday night, the groom suddenly fell ill on the garland exchange stage. He fainted and collapsed unconscious. Seeing this, chaos ensued. The bride started crying profusely. The wedding had to be stopped. Seeing the groom's condition, his family members panicked. In a hurry, the relatives took the groom to a private hospital located on Garh Road. Doctors said that the groom's blood pressure had increased. This caused the situation. The groom's condition is being reported as out of danger. The bride Anjali kept crying continuously. The women of the house consoled her. The bride said, 'My life is ruined. He was intoxicated on the garland exchange stage. There was a smell coming from his mouth.' The girl refused to marry. There was also an argument between the groom's and bride's sides. Finally, the wedding procession returned. The matter is from Kotwali Nagar area. Now know the entire incident in sequence The wedding procession came from Ghaziabad The wedding procession of Mintu, son of Mahendra Singh, a resident of Vijay Nagar in Ghaziabad, arrived in Hapur on Saturday night. There was dancing and singing to DJ music in the procession and the atmosphere was cheerful. The groom was also dancing with his friends and family members. After the door worship ceremony, the garland exchange ritual began. Groom Mintu reached the stage. The bride had also arrived. Just then, Mintu suddenly started feeling dizzy. He collapsed on the stage. Seeing this, there was panic among the bride's side and the wedding guests. Family members immediately admitted the groom to a nearby hospital. The groom's friend Lalit Sharma said that Mintu is fine now, but due to this incident the wedding rituals could not be completed and the program had to be stopped. After the incident, the atmosphere deteriorated. The bride's side expressed their displeasure by stopping the wedding procession and refused the marriage. It is alleged that the groom's side was misbehaved with and there was an argument between both sides, which escalated the dispute. During this, someone gave false information to the police about firing at the wedding ceremony. Chaos situation at marriage hall for one and a half hours Police reached the spot as soon as they received the information, but upon investigation, the firing incident turned out to be completely false. A chaotic situation prevailed at the marriage hall for about one to one and a half hours. Police intervened and brought both parties to the police station to calm the situation. The bride's side accused the groom of being intoxicated with alcohol, while the groom's side denied it. Along with this, a dispute has also come to light regarding the demand for a Scorpio car as dowry. The bride's brother-in-law says that the groom was intoxicated. He was taken to the hospital. Where it was confirmed that he was intoxicated. He said that the girl's life has been ruined. Earlier, the boy's side had demanded a big car. But after persuasion, it was agreed to give a small car. The groom had a seizure on stage Bride Anjali said - My life has been ruined, as soon as I went on stage, he had a seizure. His teeth were clenched. He was grinding his teeth. Anjali said that the groom's family had demanded a car. Which her father somehow gave by taking a loan. On stage he was intoxicated. There was a smell coming from his mouth. In this matter, an attempt was made to know the groom's side, but no one came forward. Station In-charge Vinod Pandey said- Police had received information about firing, but nothing of that sort was found upon reaching the spot. Due to the groom's deteriorating health during the garland ceremony, a rumor spread in the confusion, whereas no incident like firing occurred at the spot. The entire matter is being investigated and further action will be taken based on facts.

stories.title: Mother rushes to killer's house to avenge Bulandshahr triple murder:Sister says, 'Set their houses on fire'; heavy police forces deployed
stories.summary: The case of the murder of two brothers and a nephew of a BJP leader in Bulandshahr is in the headlines. When Manish was shot at a birthday party on Saturday night, his mother had gone to Ayodhya for darshan. Upon returning, when she learned about the incident, she ran towards the accused's house to take revenge. After much effort, family members calmed her down. After this, she fainted while crying and wailing. Meanwhile, sister Rajni said, 'Come with me, set fire to their houses. Brother was called on the pretext of a feast and then he was killed without reason. I want revenge for my brother's blood. The demand from CM Yogi is that strict action should be taken against the culprits.' What did the family members say about the incident, read the report... The case at a glance In Bulandshahr, during a birthday party on Saturday night at 12 o'clock, the brother, cousin and nephew of a BJP leader were murdered. A party was going on in the gym. Eyewitnesses said that the BJP leader's cousin smeared cake on the face of the accused birthday boy. This enraged him. First there was an argument. After this, the accused along with his companions opened indiscriminate fire on the BJP leader's brothers and nephew. Manish Saini (30), Aakash Saini (19) and Amardeep Saini (32) lost their lives in the firing. Manish was the younger brother of BJP councillor Sanjay Saini of Ward No. 24, while Aakash was his nephew and Amardeep was his cousin's son. What the family has to say Simran, wife of the deceased Amardeep, said - He had left home saying he was going to some party or cake function. He said he would be back soon. Someone called his nephew, who also said the same thing that he would be back soon. Both did not return. Everything happened according to a plan. CCTV cameras had already been removed from there. The police are not taking any action. My husband had no old enmity. Everyone was friends. They lived together well. I want justice. Sister said, ‘We have lost two, they should also lose two’ Amardeep's sister Radha said - Bulldozers should be run on the accused's houses and factories. Blood for blood is needed. Two dead bodies have been taken from our house. My brother and my nephew have been killed. Sister-in-law called me, then I came to know about this tragedy. Police is not doing anything. The monsters are sitting comfortably. Just as I have lost two, they should also lose theirs. There was a heated argument between the police and the relatives of the deceased. They had a heated debate with Station House Officer Inspector Premchandra. The relatives said that now we want blood for blood. Three of ours have died, so three from their side should also die. Force from 10 police stations deployed at accused's house Considering the seriousness of the situation, apart from police force from 10 stations, 2 companies of PAC have been deployed at the accused's house. The deceased and the accused are residents of the same locality. Their houses are also nearby. Now understand the entire incident in sequence FIR registered against 10, 4 in custody According to police, accused Jeetu and Mayank Saini are the main accused in the case. Jeetu fired with Mayank's pistol. After the incident, the accused fled with the CCTV DVR. Police have registered an FIR against 10 people including Jeetu-Mayank. 4 have been taken into custody and are being interrogated. Search for the rest is ongoing. ADG says, ‘Three people have been arrested, 8 teams engaged in investigation’ The ADG informed that on the night of 25-26, information was received at Kotwali Khurja Nagar in Bulandshahr that Amardeep, Aakash and Manish, all three were present in the gym where a birthday program was going on. During this, a dispute arose over something, which escalated. Three people have been arrested in the case so far. Eight teams are working on this case. The entire situation will be clarified by this evening. The preliminary investigation suggests that the bullet was fired from a .32 bore revolver, however, this can only be confirmed after the postmortem report arrives. Orders given to form SIT On government instructions, ADG Meerut Zone Bhanu Bhaskar has ordered the formation of an SIT to investigate the case. Following this, DIG Kalanidhi Naithani has assigned the investigation responsibility to IPS Antariksh Jain. A report has been demanded within 48 hours regarding the functioning of Kotwali police. It is believed that action against Kotwali police is certain in this matter.

stories.title: Shadab Jakati holds roadshow without permission, police to file case:Controversial YouTuber opens jewellery story, cricketer Rinku Singh's sister also attends
stories.summary: The famous social media influencer Shadab Jakati, known for "10 rupees ka biscuit kitne ka hai ji" (How much is the 10 rupee biscuit), is facing a case for conducting a road show without permission. Today, Shadab opened his jewelry showroom named Jakati Jewellers. During the road show, a huge crowd gathered at Hapur Adda. Cricketer Rinku Singh's sister Neha Singh along with many other influencers also attended this program. It is being reported that Nauchandi police station officers reached the spot and stopped Shadab Zakati's road show. They also dispersed the crowd that had gathered there. After this, the police is going to file a case against Zakati. See the pictures of the road show... Shadab Zakati launched his jewelry showroom named Zakati Jewellers in Meerut on April 26. On the occasion of this showroom's opening, Shadab Zakati organized a road show without permission. A large crowd gathered there. Cricketer Rinku Singh's sister Neha Singh along with many influencers also attended this program. Due to this, chaotic situations arose on the road. Suddenly the situation deteriorated at the spot. After this, the police station reached the spot on receiving information. The police first cleared the way by removing the crowd. After this, during investigation it was found that this road show was being taken out without permission by Shadab Zakati. Following this, the police have registered a case against Shadab Zakati. This jewelry showroom has been opened in Brand Square Complex, Hapur Road. Who is Shadab Zakati? Shadab is a resident of the Inchauli area of Meerut, Uttar Pradesh. He is fond of cricket. He has worked as a driver in Saudi Arabia. He started making videos from there itself. A video of Shadab ''How much is the packet of 10 biscuits sir...' has become a hit. Crores of people have watched it. Many celebrities including rap singer Badshah, cricketers Rinku Singh and Kuldeep Yadav have copied this video. Shadab Zakati is fond of cricket. He has previously worked as a driver in Saudi Arabia. He started making videos from there itself. Now he has become a big identity on social media. Know about the controversy related to Shadab Zakati The video of Shadab Zakati that sparked controversy was made by him with his daughter. In the video, he appeared with a girl and two women. In this, Shadab is sitting at a grocery store. The girl comes to buy goods. When Zakati asks for money, she says that mom will come and pay. He makes indecent comments to the girl. Then he comments on her mother. He says that when she is so beautiful, how beautiful her mother must be. After this, he reaches that girl's house. When he calls out, a woman opens the door of the house. Shadab says to the woman that your daughter came and took the goods. Now what will you pay? Just give me a KISS. Meanwhile, the minor comes out from inside the house with a woman. She tells Zakati that uncle, this is my mother, who is with me. After this, Zakati starts asking for money. An FIR has been filed against this video based on a complaint by BJP leader Rahul Thakur. On November 27, the police arrested Shadab. After getting bail, Shadab thanked people for their support and said that he had not done anything wrong. However, since people expressed displeasure over a video, the video has been deleted.

stories.title: Mother collapses from shock after father kills son:Accused committed suicide after killing 3-year-old in Jhansi
stories.summary: In Jhansi, after murdering his 3-year-old only son, father Prem Singh Raikwar (38) committed suicide. The child's mother Asha is unable to bear this shock. She has lost her senses. She is in a terrible state from crying. She keeps fainting repeatedly. She is being brought back to consciousness by sprinkling water on her. As soon as she regains consciousness, she starts searching for her son. When the son was not visible, she went into the room and brought out his clothes. Considering the clothes as her son, she started caressing them. Seeing this, when her sister-in-law tried to snatch the clothes, she said crying - 'Don't snatch my son.' She clung to the clothes and started crying bitterly. Then she fainted and fell down. When relatives tell her that son Bharat has died, she says, 'If he had to kill, he should have killed me. He should not have cut my piece of heart with a knife. There wasn't even that much of a fight. I had thought he was sleeping with his father. If I had known, I would never have let him sleep. Alcohol has destroyed the home.' The entire incident is from Dhimarpura village in Raksa police station area late Friday night (April 24). See these 3 pictures... Now understand the entire matter in a sequential manner- Prem Singh Raikwar (38), a resident of Dhimarpura village in Raksa, used to do farming. He had married Asha about 6 years ago. They have two daughters Tulsi (5) and Vinita (4). The youngest son was Bharat (3). Prem Singh and another brother Lakhpat lived in the village, while four brothers live with their father in a house built on a farm about 500 meters away from home. Neighbors told that Prem used to drink a lot of alcohol. On Friday, there was the wedding of Sumit, son of neighbor Jahar Pal. Prem had gone to it. Prem had drunk a lot of alcohol at the wedding. He was serving food to the pangat (row of diners) in an intoxicated state. Somehow people managed him. Returned after drinking alcohol and incident after fight with wife Wife Asha said - On the evening of April 24, husband Prem had gone to eat at a neighbor's wedding. He came home at 1 am after drinking alcohol from there. When I asked the reason for drinking, he started fighting. Then I told my mother-in-law. When mother-in-law scolded him, he went to the room and lay down. After a while, he took my son Bharat from beside me. I saw it, thought he is lying next to his father. The room gate was open then. Then I fell asleep. After a while when I woke up, the room gate was closed. I thought the child didn't come to drink milk. Then I knocked on the door but got no response. When I looked through the window, my husband was hanging from a noose, but the child was not visible. Then sister-in-law Rachna woke up. I knocked on the door again, because I thought the child would get up and open the door, but that didn't happen. Then when I looked through the window again, the child was lying on the ground covered in blood. His throat had been cut with a knife. Seeing this, I was shocked. Had quit alcohol after visiting Ratangarh temple Asha further said that her husband used to drink a lot of alcohol. There used to be disputes over this matter. Some time ago I had gone to my maternal home. After just one month, my husband came to take me back and promised that he wouldn't drink alcohol. Then I also came back. Last month we went to Ratangarh temple. There, the husband promised to quit alcohol. He didn't drink for a month, but had started drinking again for the past 5 days. There was no indication that he would commit this act. He was a piece of my heart. He loved him very much too. But, he killed him. Intoxication was swirling in his mind. This alcohol destroyed my home. Elder brother-in-law was not at home, woke up hearing sister-in-law's voice Jethani Rachna said - I was sleeping in the room with my children. My husband had gone to a wedding in the neighborhood. I woke up late at night hearing Devarani Asha's voice, then came to know about the incident. I ran to the field and called and brought my family members. After that, I dialed 112 and informed the police. The police arrived at the spot shortly after. The police broke the door and went inside the room. By then both had died. The brother-in-law committed this crime under the influence of alcohol. CO said - Investigating the reasons for suicide CO Sadar Ramvir Singh said - Prima facie it appears that the father killed his daughter and then committed suicide by hanging. An investigation is being conducted to find out the reasons.

stories.title: Fake doctor posed as Heart, TB specialist at Lucknow's KGMU:12th pass 'doctor' would hold fake medical camps to deceive students
stories.summary: An old video related to fake doctor Hassam Ahmed, who passed 12th class, has surfaced at KGMU. In it, Hassam Ahmed is presenting himself as a doctor and raising awareness about TB prevention. After the video came to light, it is being suspected that apart from heart, he was also misleading patients connected to many other departments of KGMU. The doctor from DM Cardiology whose name came up in connection with Hassam Ahmed has also clarified this matter. It has been said from his side that till date he has never met Hassam Ahmed nor is he acquainted with him. Hassam's associate Faiq is a resident of Moradabad According to information received from KGMU, the co-founder of Hussam Ahmed's NGO 'Cardio Seva' is Kaif Ahmed Mansoori. He is originally a resident of Moradabad. During his course at LARI, he had started working at some private clinics. During this time, he began to establish connections with several private hospitals and nearby doctors. Within a few years, he had built contacts with many doctors in Lucknow. Camps had more doctors and medical students Another fact has emerged about the medical camps organized by Hussam Ahmed. In these camps, the number of patients and attendants was negligible, but there was a large number of doctors and medical students present in the camps. To the extent that there was also a large stock of medicines available. Additionally, medical equipment was also present. The objective was to make the medical camp appear large and grand to impress MBBS students. On April 20, Dr. KK Singh went to a medical camp in old Lucknow. There he saw a large number of female MBBS and paramedics students on site. The most disturbing thing was that while everyone talked about taking care of patients through the medical camp, the number of patients present was almost negligible. Had deep penetration in many other departments besides LARI After it came to light that Hassam Ahmad had multiple connections in KGMU's LARI Cardiology, it is now emerging that he had infiltrated other departments as well. In a video released on World TB Day, Hassam Ahmad can be seen creating awareness among people about TB. In this context, there are also apprehensions that he may have deep links in the Respiratory Medicine and Pulmonary Medicine departments as well. It is being said that by showing these videos to Hindu female medical students, Hassam would attempt to bring them to medical camps. Emphasis being given on conducting thorough investigation In the initial investigation, where only a case of treating patients with fake degrees and identity came to light, this matter is pointing towards an organized network. After the name of a doctor who has completed DM from LARI Cardiology Department came to the fore, intelligence agencies have become alert. The concerned doctor has been associated with KGMU campus for a long time. His several contacts have been active both inside and outside the institution. The investigation team is now closely examining his old records, call details, social network, professional activities and details of his association with the foundation. Along with this, it is also being investigated whether he provided protection or guidance to fake doctors at any level. Investigation continues into possible involvement of insider doctor KGMU spokesperson and Dean Dr. KK Singh says that taking this incident seriously, an internal investigation has been initiated. All suspicious links connected to the campus, old registrations and academic records are being reviewed. It is also being investigated whether there was any kind of lapse or negligence in the institution's processes, which could have been exploited by fake doctors to become active. Cardiologist denied going to the camp Meanwhile, in this matter, a statement from Dr. Ahmad Tanveer, who is pursuing DM Cardiology at KGMU, has also come to light. Dr. Ahmad stated that he never went to Hussam Ahmad's Cardiac Service Institute camp, nor does he know the fake doctor. According to Dr. Ahmad, about 2 months ago, a young man named Fahad Ahmad Mansuri came to my clinic looking for work. He had completed a technician course from LARI. Since I am also a LARI graduate, I hired him on a part-time basis. Two technicians were already working at my place. He used to come for 2-3 hours in the evening. I didn't have any special conversation with him. Work was taken from him in a professional manner; there is no information about his personal life. Very soon I will meet with the KGMU administration and definitely present my side to them as well.

stories.title: Female student's body found hanging from tree:Bite-marks on back; mother alleges rape, murder
stories.summary: In Pratapgarh on Sunday, the body of a 19-year-old girl was found hanging from a tree. Undergarments and slippers were recovered 20 meters away from the body. A person from the same village saw the body hanging from the tree at 7 AM in the morning. After this, he informed the family members and the police. The mother who reached the spot broke down after seeing the body. The mother alleged while crying - the daughter was brutally killed after rape. Her clothes are soaked in blood. There are scratches and bite marks on the body. The body has been hung from the tree to make it look like suicide. The police spoke to the family members about the incident and started the investigation after sending the body for post-mortem. According to the police, the young woman's body was found in a mango orchard 100 meters away from her house. Injuries and teeth marks have been found on the body. The case is from a village in Manikpur police station area. Understand the entire case in a sequential manner Had recently passed the Intermediate examination The young woman's family consists of parents, six sisters, and four brothers. The young woman was fifth among her sisters. Her father supports the family by driving an e-rickshaw. The deceased had recently passed the Intermediate examination with 73% marks. CO Kunda Amarnath Gupta said- Information was received about the murder of a young woman. Upon receiving the information, the local police and senior officers immediately inspected the scene. The body has been taken into custody and sent for post-mortem. An investigation is underway to solve the case.

stories.title: Husband murders wife and mother-in-law by slitting their throats:Entered in-laws' house at night through the roof; injured 3-year-old son by throwing him from cot
stories.summary: In Ballia, late Saturday night, a husband murdered his 23-year-old wife and mother-in-law by slitting their throats with a knife. The accused picked up his 3-year-old son from the cot and threw him, causing injuries to the child. He also attacked his father-in-law with a knife when he came to intervene. His condition is critical. According to police, the accused had reached his in-laws' house at night. He parked his bike at some distance from the house and entered through the roof. After committing the crime, he fled from the scene. Police's initial investigation has revealed that the accused Amit Gupta had eloped from home four years ago and had a love marriage with Preeti. At that time, Preeti's father was against this marriage because Amit was addicted to alcohol. However, later the family had accepted their relationship. According to police, after marriage the accused started demanding a car from his in-laws. When the demand was not fulfilled, he would beat his wife. About 10 days ago, he had also attacked his wife with a knife, after which Preeti came to her maternal home with her son. He was calling his wife back, but angered by her refusal, he committed the crime. This incident is from the Nagra police station area of Ballia. Know the Complete Case Accused JCB Driver, Got Married in Temple 4 Years Ago According to police, Bachaipur village is 40 kilometers away from the district headquarters. Painter Antu Gupta, a resident here, had arranged the marriage of his daughter Preeti alias Bunty with Amit, a resident of Sinhachwar, 4 years ago. Amit is the eldest of three brothers and operates a JCB. Sister-in-law Kriti Gupta told - After the marriage was fixed, father came to know that Amit drinks alcohol. Therefore, he called off the wedding. Sister and Amit used to talk a lot on phone. Sister got influenced by him and fell in love with him. She eloped with Amit and married him in the village temple. However, later the family accepted their relationship. Had also attacked wife with knife 10 days ago The sister-in-law said, ‘At the time of marriage, Amit had no demands, but later he started demanding a car. When the family refused, he often started beating my sister. A month ago, there was a fight between the two. A panchayat was held in the village, although no decision was made. After this, father brought Preeti home. 15 days ago, Amit had come to take her.’ She said, 'When the sister refused to go, he started threatening to stab himself with a knife. After this, the sister went to her in-laws' house. The brother-in-law kept the sister in another house in the village. 10 days ago, he beat the sister very badly and also stabbed her with a knife. When father came to know about it, he brought the sister home 10 days ago. Since then, the sister had been staying here. He was repeatedly calling her, but the sister was not going. He was angry about this matter.' Parked the bike at a distance, reached on foot and entered the house through the roof Sister-in-law Kriti Gupta said, 'Amit reached our house on his bike around 12:30 am on Saturday night with the intention of murder. He parked the bike at some distance from the house. The door was locked from inside, so he climbed the neighbor's wall and entered the house through the roof. He went to my sister's room. She was sleeping with her son. He picked up the son in his arms and tried to flee, but the son's sleep broke and he started shouting Mummy-Mummy.' Slit wife's throat, when son cried, picked him up from cot and threw him Sister-in-law said, 'Hearing the noise, sister Preeti also woke up. She started trying to stop Amit. Meanwhile, Amit took out a big knife and slit Preeti's throat. He also picked up the son from the cot and threw him. Hearing Preeti's scream, mother Susheela Devi reached the room. Amit attacked her too. First stabbed her in the stomach, then stabbed her several times behind the neck. When I tried to catch him, he tried to kill me by strangling me.' He said, ‘He was about to stab me when Papa came into the room. When Papa tried to catch him, he pounced on him. First he stabbed him on the shoulder, then stabbed him several times in the stomach. When Papa ran outside screaming, neighbors started gathering.’ Meanwhile, Amit found an opportunity and fled. Sister Preeti and mother Sushila died on the spot. People from the vicinity took father to CHC. After primary treatment, doctors referred him to Varanasi. SP Omveer Singh said, As soon as information about the incident was received, the Nagra station in-charge reached the spot. The bodies have been sent for post-mortem. The forensic team has collected evidence from the spot. Three teams have been deployed for the arrest of the accused. Raids are being conducted to search for him. Keeping in view the incident, PAC has been deployed in the village. Neighbors say, ‘Such a murderer should be hanged’ Neighbor Rajendra Yadav said, ‘We came to know about the incident at 8 am. When we went into the room, blood was splattered everywhere inside. He has been killed very brutally. Such a murderer should be hanged.’

stories.title: Passing out parade of 493 women constables in Gorakhpur:Rigorous training conducted before joining UP police force
stories.summary: A grand passing-out parade of women recruit constables was held on Sunday at the parade ground of Gorakhpur Police Lines. The event was a special occasion for 493 women trainees who successfully completed their rigorous training with discipline and dedication. They will now join the police force and contribute to strengthening law and order. On the occasion, DIG Gorakhpur Range S. Channappa took the salute of the parade and encouraged the trainees. He said that the increasing number of women police personnel will make the police system more efficient and sensitive. In fact, large-scale police training began across various training centres in the state from 21 July 2025. In Gorakhpur too, 493 women trainees underwent nine months of intensive training, which included physical fitness, knowledge of law, handling emergency situations, weapons training, and discipline. The parade showcased excellent discipline. The march past was led by Akanksha Yadav, while 12 platoons participated with precision. Ajita Singh and Anjali Tiwari also played key roles during the parade. During the programme, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath virtually extended his greetings to around 60,000 trainees across the state. He said that the newly trained police force will further strengthen security in Uttar Pradesh. Outstanding performers among the women constables were also honoured during the event, boosting their confidence. Senior Superintendent of Police Dr. Kaustubh addressed the trainees and said this is just the beginning of their careers and they must always work with honesty and responsibility. The trainees were also awarded certificates and prizes by the District Magistrate of Gorakhpur and the Senior Superintendent of Police. At the end of the ceremony, all recruits took an oath of duty, loyalty to the Constitution, and commitment to public safety and confidentiality. After the oath, the platoons marched out with pride. Senior police officials including SP City, SP South, SP North, along with other officers and staff were present. After training, 256 women constables will be deployed in Gorakhpur, while 237 will be sent to Kushinagar. In addition, 983 new constables from other centres will also join Gorakhpur. In total, 1,239 new police personnel will be deployed across different police stations for training and duty. Their deployment will strengthen the police force in the district and help improve crime control. With an increased presence of women police personnel, cases involving women are expected to be handled more swiftly and sensitively. Several senior officials, trainers, parents, and local residents attended the programme. The event was marked by discipline, enthusiasm, and pride as the women constables began a new chapter in public service.

stories.title: Kanpur youth's bank account used in crores-scale fraud:Illegal transactions linked to GST racket, accused absconding for 3 months
stories.summary: A shocking case of cyber fraud and financial irregularities has emerged from Chakeri police station area in Kanpur, raising serious questions over the banking system and GST network. A young man was allegedly threatened with death, forced to open a bank account, and later crores of rupees in illegal transactions were routed through the same account. The victim filed an FIR on Friday at Chakeri police station, demanding strict action against Nitin, Shiva, Akash, Mahfooz Alam alias Pappu Chhuri, and Mehtab. Nikhil Kumar, a resident of Juhi Parmapurwa who works in a printing press, became the victim of this entire racket. Shiva, known to him, allegedly introduced him to Nitin and Akash. He was lured into the trap with the promise of higher earnings. Forced account opening and mobile number change In October 2025, the accused allegedly took Nikhil to Axis Bank’s Ramadevi branch and forcibly opened a bank account in the name of a firm. The situation worsened further after that. It is alleged that his Aadhaar card was taken into custody and the mobile number linked to the bank account was changed, leaving him unaware of any transactions and giving full control of the account to the accused. Crores routed through fake GST billing According to the victim, his account was used for transactions worth crores of rupees through fake GST invoices. Due to the change in mobile number, he had no knowledge of any financial activity taking place in the account. Death threats after opposition When Nikhil realised the fraud and protested, the accused allegedly threatened to kill him and his family. Living under fear, the victim remained silent for a long time. The FIR also names Mahfooz alias Pappu Chhuri and Mehtab, who are said to be part of an organised gang. They are accused of creating fake companies and causing massive loss to government revenue. ₹1,600 crore suspicious transactions under probe Police investigation earlier revealed suspicious transactions worth ₹1,600 crore through 68 accounts across 12 banks, linked to an incident on 16 February in Shyamnagar area of Chakeri following a robbery case. The name of businessman Mahfooz Alam alias Pappu Chhuri had also surfaced, after which he went absconding. Multiple agencies including the Enforcement Directorate (ED), Income Tax Department, GST Department and RBI have been involved in the investigation. Police have so far arrested six accused in the case. Investigating agencies suspect the funds may have been used for terror financing or anti-national activities, as some suspects were traced to locations in Delhi and Kashmir. Despite more than three months passing, the main accused remains absconding. Station House Officer Ajay Prakash Mishra said that continuous raids are being conducted to arrest the accused, and action will be taken soon after their arrest.

stories.title: Woman returns for pagfera, attends parents’, brother’s funeral:Buries dog ‘Rudra’ with her own hands; pet's name printed on wedding card
stories.summary: Three members of a family died in a road accident while returning to Gorakhpur after their daughter’s wedding. The daughter reached her home for the pagfera ritual but attended the last rites instead. Vinay Srivastava (53), his wife Archana (48), and their son Kritarth (27) were returning from Ranchi after the wedding held on April 20. Their pet dog Rudra was also with them. The accident took place near Mau in Uttar Pradesh. Two drivers also died in the crash. Accident details After the wedding, the family started for Gorakhpur. Their car had earlier faced issues in Gaya, so they hired a Scorpio with two drivers and continued the journey. In the early morning, the Scorpio went out of control, crossed the divider, and collided with a trailer coming from the opposite direction. Police said the vehicle was moving at high speed and the driver may have dozed off. All occupants died at the spot. Last rites performed together After post-mortem, the bodies were brought home on Saturday night. On Sunday morning, the funeral pyres of the mother, father, and son were arranged together and taken to Rajghat cremation ground. Their nephew performed the last rites. Daughter performs dog’s last rites The daughter buried the pet dog Rudra herself after reaching home from her in-laws’ place. The dog was part of the family and had accompanied them on the journey. Pagfera turns into mourning The daughter had come for a post-wedding ritual but found her home in mourning. Neighbours gathered to support her as no immediate family members were left. Brother’s son performs last rites, wedding postponed The last rites were performed by the nephew. A family wedding scheduled for May 7 has been postponed after the incident.

stories.title: 3 arrested, including chemistry lecturer in UP Home Guard exam:Gang contracted to solve papers using AI; 2 fake invigilators caught
stories.summary: The second day of examination for recruitment to 42,000 Home Guard posts in UP is underway. In Kanpur, police have arrested 3 people including a chemistry lecturer for facilitating cheating in the exam using AI. BNSD Inter College spokesperson and teacher leader Akhilesh made two tuition teachers room inspectors in the college without duty. All were preparing to facilitate cheating. They had made preparations in a closed NCC class with a printer to copy the paper and AI to answer questions. Police have sent all three to jail after presenting them in court. The examination that started on Saturday at 1053 centers across the state will continue till 27th April. 25 lakh candidates will participate in it. In view of the examination, police across the state are on alert mode. The 2-hour examination is of 100 marks, in which multiple choice questions are being asked. Preparation was made to solve paper in NCC room in Kanpur Kanpur DCP Central Atul Srivastava said- BNSD Inter College Chunniganj was made the center for Homeguard examination. Here, English lecturer Lalit Bajpai was made the center administrator. Two centers Block-A and Block-B have been set up in the college. The second shift of Homeguard examination was scheduled from 3 to 5 pm on Saturday. All candidates of the second shift had gone to their classrooms after biometric verification. At 2:55 PM, a person was going from the examination room towards the washroom at Block A center. The police accompanying the Sector Magistrate stopped him. Asked where he was going. He said, ‘My name is Sandeep Chandra Vishwakarma and I am on duty as Room Inspector in Room Number-21.’ Upon checking, sealed question papers were found hidden under his shirt.' When asked, he said that Nirmal Kumar, the inspector of another room, gave him the question paper. There, during inspection in the NCC room ahead, a mobile and printer were found. Investigation revealed that college lecturer Akhilesh Yadav had given him the key to the NCC room. Two people fraudulently made room inspectors without duty assignment When room inspector Nirmal Kumar was called and questioned, he said that yes, he had given a paper to Sandeep Chandra Vishwakarma to solve. When an investigation into the duty of both was started, a shocking revelation came to light. When the duty chart was checked, the names of Sandeep Chandra Vishwakarma and Nirmal Kumar were found in the duty chart. When cross-checked with the list of room inspectors from outside the college issued by the District Magistrate's office, the names of Sandeep Kumar Vishwakarma and Nirmal Kumar were not found in that list. DCP Central Atul Srivastava stated- The investigation revealed that Akhilesh Yadav, a Chemistry lecturer working at the college, had conspired to fill the OMR sheet of an absent candidate to show them as present. Both tuition teachers Sandeep Chandra Vishwakarma and Nirmal Kumar had been wrongly assigned duty. Due to this, an FIR was registered against all three and they were arrested.

stories.title: Farmer dies of electrocution in Kanpur field:Found unconscious near tubewell, family suspects foul play
stories.summary: A 50-year-old farmer died after allegedly coming in contact with electric current from a tubewell installed in his field in Maharajpur area. The incident has raised suspicion among family members, who have demanded a detailed investigation. The deceased, Deshraj, a resident of Sikatiya Purwa village under Bithoor police station limits, is survived by his wife Seema, sons Golu alias Arun Karan and Ankit, and daughter Sanjoli. According to the family, Deshraj had gone to his field on Saturday morning for routine work. Around 11 am, his daughter Sanjoli visited the field to give him food and found him working. However, by around 1 pm, villagers informed the family that he was lying unconscious in the field. Family members rushed to the spot and found him unresponsive. They immediately dialled 112 and informed the police. Meanwhile, his son Golu, who had gone to Jhansi to appear for a Home Guard recruitment exam, returned home after receiving the information. Police from Maharajpur station reached the spot soon after being alerted and began an investigation. During preliminary inquiry, it was found that Deshraj likely came into contact with electric current from the tubewell installed in the field. However, the tubewell room was reportedly locked, which has raised doubts among the family. The police took custody of the body and sent it for postmortem to ascertain the exact cause of death. The station in-charge said that prima facie the death appears to be due to electrocution. However, considering the family’s allegations of suspicious circumstances, a detailed probe is underway. Further action will be taken based on the postmortem report.

stories.title: Public rejects 33 of UP's 40 ministers:New faces emerge top choice in 13 ministers' seats
stories.summary: The results of Dainik Bhaskar’s biggest survey have revealed that people do not want 33 of Uttar Pradesh’s 40 ministers to be fielded again. Only 3 ministers received a clear ‘yes’ from the public for another ticket, while voters could not form a clear opinion on 3 others. 4 ministers were rejected by the public because of their poor behaviour. The survey had also asked respondents why they liked or disliked their MLAs. Public rejects these ministers over behaviour There are 54 ministers in the Yogi cabinet. Of them, 14 are MLCs, who are not directly elected. Including the Chief Minister, 40 are MLAs. In the Bhaskar survey, the public rejected all 12 Cabinet ministers, 8 of 9 Ministers of State (Independent Charge), and 16 of 17 Ministers of State. Ministers who are MLCs were not included in the survey. Chief Minister remains popular in his seat In the Bhaskar survey results, Gorakhpur City MLA and Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath was rated the most popular by the public. On the Gorakhpur City seat, 89% of respondents said ‘yes’ to electing him again as MLA. On the Chief Minister’s seat, people also named the BJP as their first party preference. Public is happy with the work of these 3 ministers The results of Dainik Bhaskar App’s biggest survey show that people are satisfied with the work of 3 ministers: Now let's know the names of those 13 ministers, where new faces have left them behind Two ministers pushed to third place in their own seats In the survey, Minister of State and Mahrauni MLA from Lalitpur, Manohar Lal alias Mannu Kori, was pushed to third place by voters. Babu Vanshidhar was preferred first, while Engineer Bhagirath was placed second. A similar picture emerged for Akbarpur-Raniya MLA Pratibha Shukla, who was also placed third on her own seat. Speaker unpopular on his seat, but BJP remains No. 1 UP Assembly Speaker Satish Mahana was not preferred by voters as an MLA candidate. However, on his Maharajpur seat in Kanpur district, people still chose BJP as their first party preference. SP became first choice on seats of 9 ministers including Deputy CM BJP First Choice on 29 Ministers' Seats In the survey, BJP remained the first choice on the seats of six Cabinet ministers — Laxmi Narayan, Nand Gopal ‘Nandi’, Suresh Khanna, Baby Rani Maurya, Surya Pratap Shahi, and Yogendra Upadhyay. On the seats of seven Ministers of State (Independent Charge) — Girish Chandra Yadav, Nitin Agarwal, Kapil Dev Agarwal, Arun Kumar Saxena, Dayashankar Singh, Aseem Arun, and Gulab Devi — people also preferred BJP as the first party choice. BJP also remained the first preference on the seats of 16 Ministers of State — Mayankeshwar Sharan Singh, Dinesh Khatik, Sanjeev Gond, Baldev Singh Aulakh, Ajit Pal, Ramkesh Nishad, Manohar Lal Mannu, Sanjay Singh Gangwar, Brajesh Singh, KP Malik, Suresh Rahi, Somendra Tomar, Pratibha Shukla, Rakesh Rathore ‘Guru’, Rajni Tiwari, Satish Chandra Sharma, and Vijay Lakshmi Gautam. On these seats, the public rejected the ministers’ faces. In the survey, the reason cited was lack of development. As for the lone RLD Cabinet minister, Science and Technology Minister Anil Kumar was rejected by the public, but voters on his Purqazi seat still preferred the RLD. 5 women ministers rejected, but BJP remains preferred party There are five women MLA-ministers in the Yogi cabinet. These include Cabinet Minister Baby Rani Maurya from Agra Rural and Minister of State (Independent Charge) Gulab Devi from Chandausi. The three women Ministers of State are Pratibha Shukla from Akbarpur-Raniya, Rajni Tiwari from Shahabad, and Vijay Lakshmi from Salempur. In the Bhaskar survey results, the public rejected all five women ministers. However, on their seats, BJP remained the first party preference.

stories.title: UP hotter than Saudi Arabia, mercury crosses 47°C:Heatwave alert in 55 districts; IMD advices to stay indoors in afternoon
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh is in the grip of intense heat and scorching hot winds, with temperatures crossing 47°C for the first time this season. Over the past 24 hours, Banda was the hottest city in the country, where the heat broke a four-year record. The city recorded a daytime temperature of 47.4°C. Earlier, the mercury had crossed 47°C there on 30 April 2022. Bright sunshine has prevailed since Sunday morning. Roads are largely deserted due to holidays in offices and schools. At Gorakhpur Zoo, a bear has refused to come out of the water to escape the heat. In Varanasi, the daytime temperature touched 45°C for the fourth time in April. Earlier, the highest temperature in the city was recorded at 45.3°C on 30 April 2019. See pictures of the heat The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a heatwave alert for 55 districts today. The weather department has advised people to avoid stepping out in the sun, especially between 12 noon and 3 pm, as temperatures in most cities are expected to remain between 42°C and 45°C during the afternoon. Special care has been advised for children and the elderly. Earlier on Saturday, the weather department released a list of the country’s 41 hottest cities, of which 14 were from Uttar Pradesh. Banda’s temperature was even higher than that recorded in Saudi Arabia and Pakistan’s Jacobabad. On Saturday, Saudi Arabia recorded 31°C, while Jacobabad in Pakistan recorded 44°C. Lucknow's meteorological scientist Atul Singh said- A change in weather may begin from today. A fresh western disturbance will become active from Monday. Light rain is likely in western UP and the Terai region, along with the possibility of thunderstorms and gusty winds. If rainfall occurs, temperatures may drop by 2–3°C. Weather fluctuations are expected to continue till 30 April–1 May.

stories.title: Labourer buried alive in Aligarh trench collapse:14-foot pit caves in during pipeline repair; kin allege junior engineer forced him inside
stories.summary: A labourer died after being buried under a mound of soil while repairing a water pipeline in Aligarh on Saturday afternoon. The incident took place around 2 pm on Railway Road, where the victim had entered a 14-foot-deep pit for repair work. According to officials, the soil suddenly caved in during the operation, trapping the labourer inside. Co-workers rushed to the spot and used a JCB machine to remove the debris and pull him out. He was immediately taken to a nearby hospital, where doctors declared him dead. A video of the incident has surfaced, capturing the moment the mound of soil collapsed into the trench. The victim’s elder brother has levelled serious allegations against the Junior Engineer (JE) present at the site. He claimed that the soil was already unstable and his brother had refused to enter the pit fearing a collapse. However, the JE allegedly abused him, kicked him, and forcibly pushed him into the trench. The family further alleged that the JE fled the scene immediately after the accident. Following the death, the victim’s family and locals staged a protest at the site. In a tense standoff, they snatched the body from the police and created a commotion that lasted for nearly an hour. The situation was brought under control only after police officials assured strict action in the case. The body was later sent for post-mortem examination. First see 4 pictures Read the complete case in detail Had gone down to fix the water pipeline Mahendra (32), a daily-wage labourer from Jawan in Aligarh, lived with his family in a rented room in the city. He is survived by his wife and two children—a 16-year-old son and an 11-year-old daughter. The incident occurred during sewer line work on Railway Road. Officials said a water pipeline had burst during construction, following which a pit nearly 14 feet deep was dug by the water supply department for repairs. Mahendra had gone down into the pit on Saturday afternoon to fix the pipeline when the soil suddenly caved in, burying him alive. Brother alleges JE forced him into pit despite danger Mahendra’s brother Rajkumar, who was present at the site, alleged negligence and coercion by Junior Engineer Narendra Singh. He claimed the soil was already unstable and cracking from above. “I folded my hands before the JE and told him the soil was falling and our lives were in danger. I requested him to stop the work,” Rajkumar said. “But he refused and accused us of shirking duty. He kicked my brother and forcibly pushed him into the pit.” Rajkumar added that around 2 pm, he, Mahendra and another labourer were inside the trench when a large portion of soil collapsed, trapping Mahendra underneath. Buried under debris, declared dead at hospital Co-workers immediately began rescue efforts using a JCB machine stationed nearby and managed to pull Mahendra out of the debris. He was rushed to the district hospital, where doctors declared him dead on arrival. A video of the incident has also surfaced, showing the moment the mound of soil collapsed into the pit. Family clashes with police, demands action Following the incident, tensions escalated at the hospital. Family members and locals created a ruckus and clashed with police personnel who were attempting to send the body for post-mortem. The family briefly snatched the body from the police, demanding immediate action against the accused JE. Police from Bannadevi police station reached the spot after being alerted. The protest continued for nearly an hour before SP City Aditya Bansal assured strict action, after which the situation calmed down. The body was later sent for post-mortem. Family members alleged that the JE was directly responsible for Mahendra’s death, insisting that he had refused to enter the pit due to safety concerns. Allegations of illegal work, no safety measures Rajkumar further alleged that the work was not officially tendered to any contractor. Instead, he claimed, the JE was privately hiring labourers to carry out the work for personal gain. He also alleged that no safety equipment was provided at the site. “Workers were often called even at 2 am for work. Those who refused were harassed,” he said. However, Municipal Commissioner Prem Prakash Meena denied these allegations, stating that all safety protocols were followed. “This is a tragic accident. A detailed investigation will be conducted, and financial assistance will be provided to the victim’s family,” he said. Wife seeks justice, ₹50 lakh compensation Mahendra’s wife Bharti broke down while speaking about the loss. “He came home at 9 pm on Friday and left again at 6 am on Saturday for work. By afternoon, we were told he had met with an accident. When I reached the hospital, I found his body,” she said. Demanding justice, she asked how she would now raise her children and called for ₹50 lakh compensation along with strict action against those responsible. Probe ordered, panel formed The Municipal Commissioner said a three-member committee has been constituted to investigate the incident. The panel has been asked to submit its report within three days, following which further action will be taken. He added that ₹5 lakh financial assistance would be provided at the government level, and the contractor has been directed to support the victim’s family. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has also taken cognisance of the incident and directed officials to ensure financial aid and a thorough probe.

stories.title: Two brothers, nephew of BJP leader shot dead in Bulandshahr:Accused celebrating birthday enraged after having cake smeared on his face, opens fire
stories.summary: In Bulandshahr, a horrifying incident took place on Saturday night around midnight during a birthday party, where the brother, cousin and nephew of a BJP leader were killed. According to police, a birthday celebration was underway at a gym when the incident occurred. Eyewitnesses said the BJP leader’s cousin smeared cake on the face of the birthday boy, which led to the escalation of the dispute. Argument over cake sparks violence The accused became furious, and a heated argument broke out. Soon after, he and his associates allegedly opened indiscriminate fire on the BJP leader’s relatives. All three were killed on the spot after being hit by bullets. The accused fled the scene after the incident. Heavy police force has been deployed in the area. The deceased have been identified as: All three died on the spot due to gunshot injuries. Incident at gym in Khurja The firing took place at RJS Fitness Gym in Khurja town. The accused, Jeetu Saini, is reported to be a former city president of the Bahujan Samaj Party. After the shooting, the accused and his associates fled the scene. Police said they also took away the CCTV DVR, possibly to destroy evidence. Family alerted, chaos at scene BJP councillor Sanjay Saini said he was informed about the incident by his brother’s friend. My brother, cousin and nephew had gone to attend the birthday party. I got a call from Rupesh and rushed to the spot, but by then all three had died, he said. Family members reached the gym soon after and broke down on seeing the bodies. Police begin investigation Senior police officials rushed to the scene following the incident. A heavy police force has been deployed in the area to maintain law and order. Antariksh Jain reached the spot along with police teams, and the bodies were sent for post-mortem examination. DIG Kalanidhi Naithani said initial findings suggest the violence stemmed from a personal clash during the party. Local inquiry indicates a fight broke out among youths at the gym during a birthday celebration. Teams have been formed to arrest the accused. CCTV footage is being examined, he said. Accused absconding, teams formed Police have launched a manhunt to trace the accused and his associates. Multiple teams have been deployed, and efforts are underway to reconstruct events despite missing CCTV data. Officials said the exact sequence of events and motive are still being verified. Situation tense, probe underway The incident has triggered tension in the area, given the political links of both the victims and the accused. Authorities are maintaining a strong presence to prevent any further escalation. Police said further details will emerge as the investigation progresses.

stories.summary: In Ghaziabad, police shot dead a man accused of raping his 4-year-old niece in an encounter: two constables were also injured during the exchange of fire on Sunday and admitted to hospital. The accused, Jasim alias Chhotu, carried a ₹50,000 police reward. Know the complete case... Jasim alias Chhotu (25) was a resident of Sisauli area in Muzaffarnagar. He was living in a rented accommodation in the Tila police station area of Ghaziabad and worked as a labourer. His sister lived with her family around 100 metres away from his room. On April 11 (Saturday), he had gone to his sister’s house. The child’s father stated that around 1 PM, his brother-in-law Chhotu arrived at the house and took his daughter with him on the pretext of going for a walk. When the girl did not return home till late evening, he went to Chhotu’s room. The girl was not there. When asked about her, the accused allegedly said that he had left the child outside their house. After this, the father and mother became worried and started searching for the girl, but she could not be found. When she was still missing till late evening, a complaint was filed at the police station. Police circulated the girl’s photograph to nearby police stations. Late at night, information was received about a girl’s body found on Bikaner 80 Foota Road. On receiving the information, the family reached the spot and identified the body as their daughter. In the complaint given to police, the father alleged that his brother-in-law took the child to his house on the pretext of feeding her. He raped her there, then strangled her to death. After that, he shifted the body about 500 metres away to Bikaner 80 Foota Road, where it was dumped under a car before he returned to his room. The news is being updated

stories.title: Thar runs over brother and sister drinking juice in Mathura:Vehicle overturns after hitting shop, driver, a farmer leader, flees
stories.summary: In Mathura, a speeding Thar ran over a brother and sister standing by the roadside. Both were sitting on a red scooter outside a juice shop, drinking juice. Suddenly, a Thar vehicle hit the scooter from behind. Then, it overturned after crushing the brother and sister. Both were seriously injured in this accident. A farmer leader's sticker is affixed to the rear window of the Thar. It is thus believed that the farmer leader himself was driving the vehicle, who fled the scene immediately after the accident. CCTV footage of this incident started being rapidly shared on social media on Sunday. The time of the incident appears to be Saturday evening at 4:26 PM. The case is from the Thana Highway area. 3 pictures of the incident Then a red Thar car comes from behind, and it runs over the brother and sister along with the scooter. Know what is visible in the video It is clearly visible in the video that a red scooter is parked on the footpath by the roadside. A girl is sitting on it. A boy is standing in front of her. Both are eating and drinking something and talking to each other. Just then, a red Thar comes from behind at high speed. The Thar swerved. Then, hitting the scooter parked by the roadside, it also ran over the girl and the boy. After this, it collided with the shop and overturned. Seeing this, a crowd of nearby people gathered. Accident near Mata Temple Khushboo (23) and her brother Rajkumar (20) live in Bhagatipuram Colony, Aurangabad. On Saturday evening, around 4:30 PM, Khushboo was sitting on a scooter outside the Mata Temple near Chandanvan Colony, while her brother Rajkumar was standing there. Both were talking. During this, a red colored, high-speed Thar vehicle, out of control, collided with the scooter, crushing Khushboo and Rajkumar. In the accident, Khushboo sustained deep injuries to both her legs and head. Her right leg had to be amputated. Meanwhile, Rajkumar sustained serious injuries to his shoulder. The family members are getting the brother and sister treated in the hospital. It was reported that both siblings had come to Chandanvan Colony to drink juice. In this matter, Thana Highway in-charge Shailendra Singh stated that no complaint has been received yet. The ownership of the vehicle is being investigated. The family members are saying that they will first get their children treated, and only after that will they discuss anything further. Thar vehicle belongs to farmer leader The Thar vehicle (UP 85 BW 5248) that ran over the brother and sister does not even have a number plate at the back. On the rear window of the vehicle, it is written 'State President Western Uttar Pradesh Bhartiya Kisan Union (A)'. After the accident, the youth driving the Thar fled the scene. It is suspected that the Thar belongs to a farmer leader. The out-of-control Thar vehicle that overturned was straightened with the help of a crane. Only then did people passing on the road get relief from the traffic jam. -

stories.title: Gangrape survivor creates 40-minute chaos in Rampur mosque:Breaks glass, burns items, locks gate despite police presence
stories.summary: A gangrape survivor in Rampur created a major disturbance on Saturday by entering a mosque and vandalising it. She broke window panes and is also accused of burning religious books, a sheet and other items. She even locked the mosque from outside. At the time of the incident, a woman sub-inspector and three constables were also present with her, as she was under police protection following a High Court order. The woman continued the disturbance for nearly 40 minutes. A video of the incident has also surfaced. She is a fashion designer and make-up artist by profession. She has filed a gangrape and property grab case against four of her maternal uncles and 13 others. Two of the accused uncles are village heads of different villages, while one has been a district panchayat member for the past 25 years. Police have arrested the woman and one of her associates and sent them to jail. One accused is still absconding. The incident took place in the Shahzadnagar police station area. Now read the entire matter in a sequential manner... The victim is originally from Moradabad and has her maternal family in Dabka village under Shahzadnagar area of Rampur. Her case is being heard in the Rampur Sessions Court, and she had a scheduled hearing on Saturday. After the hearing, around 3 pm, she directly went to a mosque in the village. Before the security personnel accompanying her could react, she entered the mosque, broke window glasses, brought out items from inside and set them on fire. After this, she locked the main gate of the mosque from outside. Members of the mosque committee and local residents tried to stop her, but she became even more aggressive. She also misbehaved with people passing by. She grabbed the collar of an elderly man riding a bicycle and assaulted him. A video of the incident went viral on social media. Late on Saturday night around 10:30 pm, police registered a case at Shahzadnagar police station against the woman, her associate Azeem, and an unidentified person. Case of gangrape, kidnapping, property grabbing against maternal uncles Police said the woman’s maternal village is Dabka. She works in Mumbai as a fashion designer and make-up artist for models. Her father died in 2012. On 21 March 2024, she filed a case in Delhi against four maternal uncles and 14 others, accusing them of gangrape, kidnapping and grabbing property. The accused reportedly have close political connections. The case was transferred from Delhi Police to Rampur Police on 21 March 2024. Four accused were arrested but later granted bail by the High Court. Accused have political influence, got case transferred to Sambhal-Bijnor According to her lawyer Arif Khan, the accused used political influence to first get the case transferred from Rampur to Sambhal. In Sambhal, a trainee woman IPS officer investigated the case. Later, the case was transferred to Bijnor. In Bijnor Kotwali, then Inspector Crime Phoolchand Burma filed a final report in court, stating the allegations were false due to lack of evidence. The court dismissed the case and acquitted all four accused. Appeal in High Court, Instructions to Lower Court Challenging the lower court decision, the woman filed a petition in the High Court. The High Court directed that the case be transferred back to the lower court and ordered the Rampur SP to conduct a fresh investigation. The court also directed that she be provided police protection on every date of hearing. On Saturday, after the hearing, she left the court and went to Dabka village, where she created the disturbance at the mosque located in front of accused uncle Bablu’s house. During the incident, a woman sub-inspector and three constables deployed for her security were also present. Now read the young woman's complete allegation The woman said her mother is the only child of her maternal grandparents and there is 350 bigha of land in her grandfather’s name. After her father’s death, her maternal uncle Imtiaz Hussain alias Chintu brought her mother to his house and allegedly kept her confined for 14 years to take control of the property. She further alleged that about nine months ago she reached Dabka village and, with police help, rescued her mother and sent her to a relative in Moradabad, where her twin sister also lives. After that she went to Delhi. On 29 February, she again came to Dabka village to collect land documents. She had obtained papers from the court, after which a dispute occurred. She said that the video of her was made by the mosque’s maulana in front of uncle Bablu’s house. She claimed the accused were angered after she obtained the documents. On 13 March at around 7 pm, uncle Imtiaz Hussain alias Chintu, Irfan Hussain alias Pappu (village head of nearby Chamaraua village), Afsar Hussain alias Bablu (Dabka village head), Asrar Hussain, Maulana Latif, Irfan Haji, Asif Banda, Zakir and four unknown youths allegedly abducted her. She said they forcibly put her in a car and took her to Chamaraua, where all four uncles beat her with belts, tied her hands and feet, and repeatedly gangraped her. The accused uncle is the caretaker of the mosque where vandalism occurred The woman claimed that the mosque where she created the disturbance belongs to accused uncle Bablu, who is also the village head and mutawalli (caretaker) of the mosque. His house is located right opposite the mosque. Young woman and companion Azeem arrested, court sends them to jail Station House Officer Kuldeep Singh Rana said the woman had earlier named 14 people in serious allegations, including gangrape, kidnapping and property grabbing. The matter is under investigation as per High Court and senior officials’ directions. After returning from court, she reached the mosque in Dabka village and started vandalising it. Despite police presence, she did not stop. A complaint was filed by Dabka resident Mehboob son of Farooq, following which a case was registered against the woman and two others. Both the woman and her associate Azeem were arrested and produced before the SDM court, which sent them to judicial custody. Defence counsel Saurabh Gupta questioned the action, alleging that they were sent to jail without being heard.

stories.title: Tehsildar Rakhi Sharma transferred to Lucknow after action:Commissioner to probe claim of iPhone bribe by Firozabad DM
stories.summary: The Firozabad administration has taken action against Tundla tehsildar Rakhi Sharma (33) and attached her to the Revenue Council headquarters in Lucknow with immediate effect. Rakhi Sharma had levelled serious allegations against Firozabad District Magistrate Ramesh Ranjan, claiming that he had taken a bribe in the form of an iPhone worth ₹1.75 lakh and an Apple Watch. She alleged that she was being harassed and demanded a probe into the matter by Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. On Saturday night at 10:17 pm, the District Information Officer informed through the official WhatsApp group that disciplinary proceedings had been initiated against the tehsildar. The government has also ordered a fresh investigation into the disputed land matter, in which allegations of irregularities were made against Kalyan (district treasury) staff. This case was earlier being investigated by Rakhi Sharma. The inquiry has now been assigned to Lucknow Divisional Commissioner Vijay Vishwas Pant. First understand the entire matter in a sequential manner Rakhi Sharma, originally from Balkeshwar in Agra, has been posted as tehsildar in Tundla since 4 September 2024. She resides in a government guest house. On 16 April, she was transferred from Tundla to Shikohabad tehsil. After the transfer order, she released a video addressed to Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath alleging harassment by the DM and seeking justice. The following day, on 17 April, she held a press conference in the tehsil premises. Allegations made in press conference Rakhi Sharma alleged that DM Ramesh Ranjan and some officials were harassing her. She named an OSD Shailendra Sharma, a peskar, and a CRA, claiming that these officials formed a group against her. She said a complaint of corruption against these officials was received in July last year and she informed the DM, but instead of action, she was targeted. She alleged that her salary was withheld for eight months and later an adverse entry was issued against her without hearing her side. She further alleged that demands were made for expensive items, including an Apple Watch and an iPhone. She also claimed that the iPhone she had given is still being used by the DM and demanded an investigation into it, saying she has bills and supporting documents. Store kept open late at night for iPhone Rakhi Sharma stated that on 4 November 2025, a showroom in Agra was allegedly kept open late at night on the instructions of the DM’s OSD to arrange an iPhone. She said she was repeatedly pressured to arrange the phone despite not receiving salary. She claimed that after handing over the phone, she was still pressured to keep visiting officials and face humiliation. She also alleged being forced into complying with certain “ethical and unethical orders,” which she said she did not fully comply with. Went to High Court When Salary Didn't Come Rakhi Sharma said she waited for her salary to be released, but when it was not credited, she filed a writ petition in the High Court on 26 February. She alleged that after officials came to know about the petition, her salary was released overnight on 27 February after reopening the treasury. She further claimed that she was called to the camp office and kept confined for two hours, during which she was pressured to withdraw her petition. Had also raised questions about transfer She also questioned her transfer, stating that although she was shifted from Tundla to Shikohabad, she had not received the official transfer letter. Despite this, another tehsildar was posted in her place. The case is also linked to a land dispute from July last year, where complainant Sunayan Sharma alleged irregularities in a 42-bigha land in Usayni. The complaint, filed on the Chief Minister’s portal and at the tehsil office, alleged illegal registration of land in the names of three clerical staff of the collectorate. This matter was under investigation by Rakhi Sharma. Had told Bhaskar - Being threatened for demanding justice Land matter, which will be investigated by the Commissioner Following her allegations, the state government has initiated disciplinary action against Rakhi Sharma and attached her to the Lucknow headquarters. The disputed land case has been ordered for a fresh investigation, now to be conducted by Lucknow Divisional Commissioner Vijay Vishwas Pant.

Trump says US team heading to Pak for talks tomorrow Pakistan has tightened security ahead of possible talks between the US and Iran, with a large number of police and security forces deployed in Islamabad and surrounding areas. 2. stories.title: Akhilesh calls Fatehpur tea seller to SP office:Gifts brass pot; slams raid action and government targeting allegations
stories.summary: The tea seller whose shop was raided in Fatehpur was called to the party office in Lucknow by SP chief Akhilesh Yadav. During the press conference, he said - they are harassing the tea seller. They instigated a leader from the Muslim community to cause an assault, so that a case could be filed. They are conducting raids. The allegation is that tea is being made in aluminum utensils. They are talking about sealing the shop. Whoever is closest to Ajay Singh Bisht, come with me, see, we also have aluminum utensils in our house. Seal my house too. When they didn't spare Shankaracharya, then let's not even talk about others. Actually, the Food Safety Department had raided a tea shop in Fatehpur. They had taken tea samples and sent them for testing. Akhilesh had gone to this shop to drink tea 2 months ago. Because of this, the raid went viral on social media. On this, Akhilesh posted on 'X'. He wrote - Don't be afraid, do your work. Bad days are about to end. Key points of Akhilesh's press conference 1. No right to remain in government Akhilesh said - Today is a very auspicious day. We are from Lucknow. That's why I said, "After you." You have heard a long press conference. You have also heard the TV broadcast. Today we are meeting on the occasion of a historic victory, when the delimitation bill could not be passed. A defeat in Parliament means that the government has lost the trust of the people. It has no right to remain in government. BJP people show fear. They divide society. They serve their own interests. BJP members can do anything to gain and retain power. The BJP's CMF formula (Create, Ministerial, and Fear) has failed. Their tactics will no longer work. The defeat of the BJP has begun. Women will defeat the BJP. Today's new-thinking women will defeat them. 2. Today's woman will not be swayed by them He said - BJP is trying to win over women with old thinking, but today's woman will not be swayed by them. Their thinking about women is feudal. Keep women weak, don't give them rights.. neither of thought, nor of attire. The defeat of the bill brought to divert attention from the growing public opposition, is a defeat for the BJP. They wanted to deceive people. The opposition of the country is representing this victory. 3. It came to usurp women's rights Akhilesh said - In the name of delimitation, it had changed its form to usurp women's rights. This was not a plan to empower women, but to diminish their power. This was not a bill, but a black document of BJP's divisive politics. Even if the population of backward classes is considered 66 percent, women's participation should have been 33 percent. But they were not giving 33 percent reservation to women, they were snatching it. In fact, the very basis of the women's reservation bill was baseless. 4. Such a bill was brought to divert attention He said - Today, there are reports of exploitation of women everywhere. To divert attention from this, such bills are being brought. Our objection was that first a census should be conducted and then reservation should be given. We will not let women be deceived. This is women's appeasement. The concept of 'MP husband' would also have started, just like 'Pradhanpati' (husband of a village head). The government that loses in Parliament goes out. The public has become confident that bad days are going to end. 5. Not reservation, but women should have been made a slogan Akhilesh said - When we came to know last night that a big announcement was going to happen, I thought that a woman's name might come forward for the post of PM. Let's understand the full story of the tea shop raid Sheshman Yadav, the owner of a tea shop in Fatehpur, had stated that on Thursday, April 16, Food Safety Department officers and employees came. Akhilesh had Sheshman's tea, asked - Which leaves do you use? Has any tea shop in Fatehpur been raided before? Has the Food Safety Department in Fatehpur raided any tea shop before this? When the department's officials were asked about this, they said they would be able to tell after checking. However, department sources say that no tea shop in the district has been raided before. stories.title: 150-year-old market in Firozabad engulfed in huge fire:More than 60 shops gutted; cash worth lakhs turns to ash
stories.summary: A massive fire broke out in Firozabad's 150-year-old vegetable market, reducing more than 60 shops to ashes. Seven other shops, including a garment store located in front of the market, were also engulfed in flames. By the time people were informed of the incident late at night, most of the shops had already burned down. Six fire engines that arrived after receiving information brought the fire under control after nearly four hours of effort. This incident occurred on Saturday in Katra Bazaar of Shikohabad. The cause of the fire has not yet been determined. However, preliminary investigation suggests short circuit as a possible reason. Revenue and Fire Department teams are assessing the damage. Visuals of the fire How the incident occured There is a 150-year-old vegetable market in Katra Bazaar of Shikoabad. There are 60 shops in the market. This is the largest fruit and vegetable market in the city. Business worth lakhs takes place here daily. On Saturday late night around 2 am, a fire broke out in a shop due to some reasons. Within moments, the fire spread throughout the entire market. Before local people could get information, the flames engulfed the entire market. The fire was so horrific that flames were rising 10 feet high in the sky. The flames and clouds of smoke could be seen from several kilometers away. The fire from the vegetable market spread to another nearby market. Fire spread to seven shops there. In no time, a garment shop along with 6 other shops were also burnt to ashes. When information about the fire in the market was received, shopkeepers and people from nearby areas arrived. The fire brigade was informed. People from Shikohabad fire brigade reached the spot. However, seeing the severity of the fire, fire brigade vehicles from surrounding areas were also called. After this, 6 fire brigade vehicles brought the fire under control after 4 hours of work. Lakhs of rupees in cash burnt along with goods Mohammad Sail, who runs a shop in the market, said, 'There is a huge stock of vegetables in the market. There would hardly be any shop that doesn't have 20 thousand to 50 thousand rupees in its cash box. Everything turned to ash in the fire. Our earnings from years of hard work were destroyed in a moment.' Shopkeeper Munnalal said, ‘There are about 60 vegetable and fruit shops in the market. There are also 7 cloth shops adjacent to each other in the market. Both markets were burnt to ashes. We traders have suffered losses worth crores. Even the dog living in the market cannot be traced.’ Chief Fire Officer Satyendra Pandey said, ‘The team reached the spot as soon as information about the fire was received. Most of the shops in the market are vegetable and clothing stores. This number is around 50-60. The cause of the fire has not yet been determined. However, it appears that it happened due to a short circuit.’
