stories.title: 'INDI alliance opposing Women's Reservation Bill was like Draupadi's disrobing':CM Yogi attacks SP, Cong; says half the population won't forgive them
stories.summary: CM Yogi held a press conference in Lucknow on Sunday with BJP and allied parties. During this, he took a dig at SP-Congress regarding the Women's Reservation Amendment Bill in Parliament. Yogi said, ‘There are 78 women MPs in Parliament. PM Modi wanted to increase this, but Congress-SP became barriers. SP had an opportunity to wash away the sins of the guest house scandal. They want everything to go to their family. They opposed the bill so that no other woman gets it.’ He said, 'The Nari Shakti Vandan Act was approved in 2023. The Nari Shakti Vandan Amendment Bill was brought to implement it from 2029. A special session was called. PM Modi had said that no one's rights will be taken away. Seats will be increased in Lok Sabha and Vidhan Sabha.' He added, 'PM assured the southern states that their rights will not be reduced. The entire House should unite and give Nari Shakti their rights from 2029, but the behavior of the INDIA alliance in the House was like Draupadi's disrobing. What kind of language was used.' Yogi stated, There is anger among the women power of UP against SP and Congress. SP and Congress should apologize to half the population. Half the population is not going to forgive them. This is unforgivable. The INDI alliance has become an obstacle among women's leadership. The women power of India will not accept this. Yogi's big statements 1. Anger Due to Opposition's Anti-Women Conduct Yogi said - The entire country has witnessed the conduct of Indi Alliance parties during the Nari Shakti Vandan Amendment Bill. As soon as Modi took charge of the country's power, he had said that there are only four castes in the country - women, poor, youth and farmers. For those who looted the country to feed their families with the intention of weakening India, this was a challenge. Congress and its allied parties opposed every progressive step. There is immense anger in the minds of half the population due to the opposition's anti-women conduct. 2. SP Talked About Reservation for Muslim Women Yogi said - The Indi Alliance conspires. If the bill had been passed, Nari Shakti would have got rights. SP talked about reservation for Muslim women. SP people invoke the Constitution, but Baba Saheb had opposed reservation on the basis of religion. He had said that India cannot endure partition repeatedly, but SP demanded reservation for Muslim women. Where were the SP people when Congress snatched away the rights of Muslim women in the Shah Bano case, the INDIA alliance also opposed the Triple Talaq law. This shows their double standards. Congress and the INDIA alliance got the opportunity to rule the country for the longest time, but they did not take any steps for women, farmers, youth and the poor. 3. The government implemented several schemes for women empowerment Yogi said - In efforts for women power, the first proposal of Beti Bachao Beti Padhao was passed. The double engine government has made arrangements for the daughter's education from her birth. 26 lakh daughters have benefited. The government has implemented many schemes for women empowerment. Women have benefited from this. This has brought transformation in women's lives. Women have been advanced in all fields including education, health and defense. stories.title: 'My height increased by 5 cm, head was swollen':Astronaut Shubhanshu Shukla shares secrets of space travel
stories.summary: Indian Air Force Group Captain and Astronaut Shubhanshu Shukla has revealed another secret from his space journey. He has shared information about the changes that occurred in his body during that time. He said that his height increased by 5 cm there and his head became swollen. He shared this on Thursday at the Summer Plant Science Festival organized at NBRI in Lucknow. Shubhanshu said, ‘There was no gravitational force in space. Due to this, the heart was pumping blood upwards. This caused blood to accumulate towards the head, which was increasing the swelling in the head. The heart was shrinking, muscle mass was decreasing. Not only this, his height also increased by up to 5 centimeters. My body returned to normal 15 days after returning to Earth.’ ‘Earth is priceless, even wood is like diamonds’ Shubhanshu Shukla said that Earth looks extremely beautiful when viewed from space. Whatever is here is not only priceless but also extremely rare. That's why Earth is the most precious in the entire universe. The wood found here will not be found anywhere else in the entire space. It will be found only here, meaning wood is as precious as diamonds for other planets. It is very necessary to preserve the Earth for its beauty and the preciousness of life on it, it is necessary to stop the increasing pollution here. This is only possible when a global perspective is adopted for this. Along with this, he said that only new technology is not sufficient for Earth conservation. Discipline and strict laws are also necessary for this. 'India is growing faster than the speed of thought' During this time, Shubhanshu said that India is rapidly touching new heights in the field of space science and is moving forward at a faster pace than the world's expectations. Soon the country will have its own space station established in space. It is hoped that by 2035 we will be able to work independently on that station. Praises India's constitution for promoting scientific temper Shubhanshu mentioned that India's Constitution is the only constitution in the world that considers developing scientific temper among its citizens as a fundamental duty. While sharing his space travel experiences, he talked about experiments conducted on cyanobacteria and algae in microgravity at the International Space Station. He also narrated several interesting incidents.

stories.title: Noida violence mastermind had full data of workers:Joined labour groups 5 years ago; gathered crowd through WhatsApp
stories.summary: Aditya Anand, the main conspirator of the violent workers' movement in Noida, had been preparing for this for five years. He read about 'Mazdoor Bigul' on Facebook. He joined it in 2022. He came in contact with Mazdoor Bigul's editor Anubhav Sinha and started reporting on incidents happening in Noida's factories. During this time, he met Rupesh Rai, the head of a workers' organization. Rupesh also started going on reporting assignments with Aditya. Both of them created complete data of Noida's industry. What is the situation, what can be done? With this data, between March 30 and April 1, people from five organizations - Mazdoor Bigul, Disha Sangathan, RWPI, Naujawan Bharat Sabha and Ekta Sangharsh Samiti - gathered in a room in Arun Vihar, Sector-37, Noida. Software Engineer Aditya gathered crowd through WhatsApp Additional Superintendent of Police (STF) Rajkumar Mishra said- Planning was done at Aditya Anand's house for three days. Preparations were made on how to make Noida's industry and workers violent. Under the guise of a labor movement, a plan was made for violence, arson and damaging public property. After making the plan, these people created WhatsApp groups between 9th and 10th April. Aditya is a software engineer. Therefore, technology was used. STF nabbed from Tiruchirappalli Railway Station A non-bailable warrant (NBW) was issued against Aditya. There was a reward of one lakh on him. As soon as he got the information, he went straight from Noida to Chennai. Meanwhile, police teams were continuously conducting raids in several states to catch him. They were taking help of surveillance. During this time, he was going from Chennai to Tiruchirappalli. But, STF got wind of it. The Noida unit of STF arrested him from the station itself. Know about Aditya Anand When and how the Noida violence occured

stories.title: Akhilesh gave Smriti an opportunity by calling her 'saas-bahu wali':Sidelined after losing Amethi, will TV's 'Tulsi' make a comeback?
stories.summary: As soon as Akhilesh Yadav said in Parliament - that 'saas-bahu wali' lost, laughter echoed in the house. Smriti Irani was the target. After losing the Lok Sabha election from Amethi, Smriti may have been less visible in active politics, but she made a comeback in the TV world. Her show 'Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi' is in the news again with a new season. Smriti, who once defeated Rahul Gandhi, is now not seen in Amethi. In such a situation, the question arises - Will TV's 'Tulsi' make a comeback again? Has the Amethi defeat become a turning point in her career? Why did Akhilesh take her name in Parliament? Know about Smriti Irani in today's Sunday Big Story... Family with Political Background Father a Congress member, Mother in BJP Smriti was born in a middle-class family in Delhi. Her father Ajay Kumar Malhotra was from Punjabi and Maharashtrian background. Her mother Shibani Bagchi was from a Bengali family. This is why Smriti had a strong grip on Punjabi, Marathi and Bengali languages since childhood. Her father was a Congress member, but her mother was active in BJP. Her grandfather was also a volunteer of the Sangh. Smriti was more influenced by her mother and grandfather. Benefited from the Identity of a Cultured Daughter-in-law After completing her schooling, Smriti became active in the TV world. In the year 2000, she appeared in the serials 'Aatish' and 'Hum Hain Kal Aaj Aur Kal'. However, she gained recognition from the serial 'Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi'. By 2002, this serial started being watched in every household. This was the time when Smriti began to be recognized not by her real name, but by her serial character name 'Tulsi'. Entry into Politics Fought first election from Delhi Smriti had become popular across the country. This was the time when she stepped into politics. In 2003, she took membership of the BJP. Her influence in the party grew so rapidly that in 2004 she was made the Vice President of Maharashtra BJP Yuva Morcha. Since Smriti was a resident of Delhi, she fought her first election from the Chandni Chowk seat in 2004. She had to face defeat at the hands of Congress's Kapil Sibal. Became National President of Mahila Morcha From 2004 to 2010, the BJP was not in power at the center, but Smriti continued to promote the party. In 2008, the serial 'Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi' ended. However, Smriti's identity as a cultured daughter-in-law had reached every household. Now she became more active in Gujarat and Maharashtra. She benefited from this in 2010. She was made the National President of BJP Mahila Morcha. In 2011, the party sent her to Rajya Sabha from Gujarat. After this, Smriti Irani started appearing in a different avatar. She remained constantly aggressive towards Congress. Especially, she was seen making statements about Rahul Gandhi. Stature grew in politics Lost to Rahul Gandhi, Yet Became a Cabinet Minister This is why when the 2014 Lok Sabha elections came, Smriti was sent to contest from Congress's traditional seat Amethi. Rahul Gandhi had already been elected MP from here twice. In 2014, BJP formed the government at the center, but Smriti lost against Rahul Gandhi. Even after losing, Smriti came into the limelight. Actually, in 2009, Rahul won the election by a margin of 3.70 lakh votes. However, against Smriti, this margin reduced to 1.07 lakh. This was the reason why despite losing the election, Smriti was made a Cabinet Minister. Even after losing to Rahul Gandhi, Smriti remained active in Amethi. She started staying there intermittently. She would visit workers' homes, meet them, and help them. When the 2019 Lok Sabha elections came, Smriti turned history around. Rahul Gandhi lost the election. Smriti Irani received 4 lakh 68 thousand votes. She secured victory by 55 thousand votes. This victory greatly elevated Smriti's stature. She was made the Minister of Women and Child Development in the central government. Lost Election in 2024 Came to Amethi only once In the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, Smriti staked her claim from Amethi again. This time, not Rahul Gandhi from Congress, but Kishori Lal Sharma, who had been his MP representative, entered the fray. He defeated Smriti Irani by 1.67 lakh votes. After this defeat, Smriti Irani went to Amethi only once. On May 26, 2025, she went to Amethi on Ahilyabai Holkar Jayanti. She met with party workers there. She has not gone there again since then. Praveen Kumar Singh, District Vice President of BJP in Amethi, says - Smriti Didi's team is working in Amethi. She remains in constant contact with everyone. She keeps getting information about what is happening. Her attachment to Amethi has not diminished. She is still campaigning for BJP in different states. She will contest elections from Amethi again in the future. Became active in TV again Became famous from Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi, Season-2 Smriti is neither an MP now nor in the government. She has not been given any position in the organization either. Smriti continued to work for the party like a worker. Her activity in the party was not visible as before. This time also became a turning point in her life. Smriti moved from politics towards TV. On July 29, 2025, Smriti was once again seen on TV in the famous character of 'Tulsi Virani'. This was the second season of 'Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi'. Once again, she began to be watched in every household in the role of a woman standing up against values and challenges. The popularity of this serial can be understood from the fact that it is among the top-3 shows on Star Plus. It has a TRP of 3.2 and is trending at number 1 in the list of 'Most Watched' shows on OTT Jio Hotstar. BJP made her a star campaigner in Bengal elections Smriti once again benefited from TV popularity. BJP made her a star campaigner in the Bengal Assembly elections. She is doing rallies and road shows for BJP candidates. She is able to connect directly with the public by giving speeches in Bengali. She is famous among the public, especially among women. Before this, the party had also made Smriti a star campaigner in Bihar. However, she was not in the list of star campaigners in the Maharashtra elections. Says, ‘Focus on Parliament, not serials’ A discussion was underway in the Lok Sabha on a constitutional amendment bill to implement women's reservation. On April 16, Akhilesh Yadav said in Parliament - If seats are reserved for women, then competition among women will increase. A voice came from BJP MPs - That should happen. Akhilesh said laughingly - Your 'saas-bahu wali' lost... Here Akhilesh's reference to 'saas-bahu wali' was to Smriti Irani. 1.30 hours after this comment, Smriti responded. She wrote in a social media post: "I heard that Akhilesh ji remembered me in Parliament today...That's good. Those who got politics as inheritance also remember those who make holes in the sky on their own strength. They comment on working women who have never done any job in their life. Shift focus from serials to Parliament. Get the important bill passed for women's support." The next day, i.e., on April 17, Akhilesh Yadav posted a shayari on social media. He wrote, "If every matter hadn't reeked of conspiracy, People would have believed if the talk hadn't been mere rhetoric, Actually, if friendship with the public had been maintained, Then the moment of farewell wouldn't have arrived so soon." Smriti said, ‘Their staying in opposition is certain’ On April 17, Smriti Irani reached Varanasi. There she said, ‘A working woman like me went to Congress stronghold Amethi and defeated the National President. If you have so much courage, then leave your ancestral seat and contest from Gorakhpur and show us.’ She said, ‘It is easy to comment on women like us, especially for those who have never done any job. We people pay taxes, not so that saas-bahu (mother-in-law daughter-in-law) matters are discussed inside the Lok Sabha. One should go to Parliament and focus on their parliamentary work.’ 'I am happy that their staying in opposition in UP is certain, because those who do politics in UP spend so much time roaming village to village that a serious leader doesn't get time to watch serials,' she added. What do the people of Amethi say? 'Smriti's team is active, the public is remembering them' We spoke to many people in Amethi regarding Smriti Irani's activeness. Senior journalist Vindeshwari Mishra says - the people of Amethi are remembering Smriti Irani. The main reason for this is that the expectations with which the public elected Kishori Lal Sharma in 2024, he has not lived up to them. The public is recalling the tenure from 2019 to 2024. Smriti used to continuously work here for development.

stories.title: Lucknow-Kanpur Expressway cuts journey from 3 hours to 45 minutes:Toll 3 times higher than highway; may be inaugurated next month
stories.summary: The Lucknow-Kanpur Expressway is ready and complete. It is among UP's shortest expressways, but travellers will have to pay 3 times the toll as compared to the National Highway on it. Now the journey from Lucknow to Kanpur will be completed in just 45 minutes instead of 3 hours. Vehicles will be able to run at a speed of 120 km on the high-speed expressway. However, only cars and vans are allowed to run, bikes will not be permitted. Of the 63 km long expressway, 18 km is elevated (road built on pillars). CCTV cameras installed for surveillance can see up to a range of 500 meters. Facilities like fuel stations, restaurants, trauma centers and parking are being built along the way for travellers. Toll tax boards have also been installed. It is being said that its inauguration will also take place next month. In such a situation, will people get those facilities? To see this, Bhaskar's team traveled on the expressway. How accurate are the claims are? Read the report… Traffic started running till Banthra before inauguration Our team reached National Highway-27. We proceeded from Lucknow towards Chaudhary Charan Singh Airport (Amausi). There was a traffic jam on the main road. Passing through this, we reached Sarojininagar. From here we tried to climb onto the elevated bridge. We saw that stones were placed blocking the road. However, one section was open. Bikers were going onto the expressway from here. Actually, the expressway is closed for common people. However, people have started using it till Banthra. After talking to NHAI officials, we took permission for coverage of the entire expressway. After this, we got onto the expressway. After travelling about 3-4 km, we saw Scooter India (old factory). At this point, the road was elevated. We looked down below. On National Highway-27, where there used to be traffic jams, people were now able to drive their vehicles comfortably. Service lanes y for Outer Ring Road After going a little further, the elevated road descended downwards, because ahead is the Lucknow Outer Ring Road. If someone comes from Kanpur and needs to go to Raebareli, Sitapur, Hardoi, Sultanpur, they won't need to enter Lucknow city. They can pass through this route. The Outer Ring Road is built in an area of about 105 km. Service roads have been constructed here for getting on and off the Ring Road. Transmission lines are passing through monopoles After travelling 12 km on the expressway, we reached Gauri Chauraha in Banthra. It was found that this section took the longest time to build the expressway. Actually, 1.32 lakh volt transmission lines pass through here. To shift them, 3 monopoles needed to be built. After the monopoles were built, they were sent to Hyderabad for testing. Only 2 monopoles passed the testing. The third monopole had to be built again. After passing the testing, it was brought to Lucknow. Only then could the transmission lines be shifted. After that, the expressway could be built here. The expressway and highway separated at Bani spot Most of the expressway passing through Lucknow is elevated. The reason for this is that the National Highway exists below. From Amausi to Darogakheda, the expressway is 4 lanes. Beyond this, from Bani (name of the place), the expressway and highway separate. This expressway is built in a greenland area. Meaning there was no road here before. It goes through the villages of Datauli, Kantha, Taura, Nerona in Unnao district up to Amarsaas. Our vehicle went over these villages. The construction of the road has been completed. Will have to pay 3 times more toll A total of 4 toll plazas have been built on the entire expressway. If you travel by car, the one-way toll will be 275 rupees. If you return within 24 hours, the total toll will be 410 rupees. Currently, to reach Kanpur from the highway, one has to go through the Nawabganj toll plaza. The car toll on the highway is 95 rupees. This means you will have to pay three times more toll to travel on the expressway instead of the highway. Restaurants and fuel stations to be built There are plans to provide facilities like fuel stations, restaurants, trauma centers and parking on the expressway. While passing through Unnao, we found several empty spots along the road. Officials from NHAI informed that restaurants and fuel stations are to be built at different spots. Meanwhile, the trauma centre will be built near the toll plaza. According to officials, their construction will be carried out after the inauguration. For now, Rest and Service boards have been installed on the expressway. Why is the Expressway special? High-tech cameras While travelling on the Expressway, CCTVs are visible every 1 km. NHAI officials said that 63 CCTVs have been installed on the entire Expressway. These cameras are so powerful that they can see clearly up to 500 meters. The zooming power is good. They can move upwards and downwards. 6 Interchanges As many as six interchanges have been built at different locations on the road. People can enter and exit the expressway from here. The main toll spot is located after Shaheed Path. Then two spots have been built in Lucknow itself and in Harauni. The remaining two have been built in Unnao at Ajgain and Amarsaas. Then the main toll is at Azad Chowk in Kanpur. Online challan 21 CCTVs have been installed for surveillance at the interchanges. Officials claim that those coming on the road from the wrong direction will be challaned by monitoring these cameras. Accident alert The expressway is also special because 16 VIDS (Video Incident Detection System) cameras have been installed to alert about accidents, fires and stationary vehicles. These cameras are equipped with AI. They will send messages to the control room. Help will be sent from there. Control Room management Two control rooms have been built on this road. First at 27 km. Second at 35 km. Monitoring will be done from here. Union Road and Transport Minister Nitin Gadkari claims that people can reach from Lucknow to Kanpur in 45 minutes. However, this doesn't seem to be happening. Underpasses, 6 flyovers, 28 small bridges built on links Underpasses were built where there were link roads on the expressway. 38 such underpasses were seen. 6 flyovers, 3 large and 28 small bridges have been constructed, so that vehicles can run at high speed (120 km). Until now, people used to rely on National Highway-27 to go from Lucknow to Kanpur. The distance between both cities via the highway is 93 km. After the road, people only had the option of train. The distance between the two cities by train is 74 km. The journey by train takes 2 hours. Direct flights have not been started between Lucknow-Kanpur. There are connecting flights, but the travel cost reaches up to 7 to 8 thousand rupees. Why the Lucknow-Kanpur expressway had to be built There used to be traffic jam situations on the Lucknow-Kanpur highway. Keeping this in view, it was decided that an expressway should be built between the two cities. In November 2018, the Detailed Project Report (DPR) of this project was submitted to the UP government, but the work stopped due to Corona. Land acquisition was completed between September 2020 and February 2021. Farmers were given approximately 900 crore rupees as compensation. Construction began in April 2021. It passes through 11 villages of Lucknow and 31 villages of Unnao district. Why is it called the most expensive expressway? According to NHAI officials, 4700 crore rupees were spent to build the 62.7 km long road. That means approximately 75 crore rupees were spent to build 1 km of road. The 594 km long Ganga Expressway was built at a cost of 37 thousand 350 crore rupees. That means approximately 63 crore rupees were spent per km. Thus, this will be the most expensive expressway so far. The reason for this is the higher circle rates of land here. Farmers were given 900 crore rupees just as compensation. Economic impact

stories.title: Father slits throats of 11-year-old twin daughters in Kanpur:Accused calls police himself; motive for murder yet to be uncovered
stories.summary: On early Sunday morning in Kanpur, a man murdered his 11-year-old twin daughters. The father slit their throats inside the flat and then informed the police himself. He has been arrested. DCP South Deependra Nath Chaudhary said that the accused, Shashi Ranjan Mishra, a medical representative, lived in Trimurti Apartment in Kidwai Nagar under the Naubasta police station area. He lived with his wife Reshma Kshetri and their three children, 11-year-old twin daughters Riddhi and Siddhi, and a 6-year-old son, Gannu. Around 4:30 am on Sunday, police received information about the murders via the emergency number 112. When police reached the flat, both girls’ bodies were found lying side by side on the floor. The entire room was covered in blood. Their throats had been slit, and a knife was found nearby. The accused father was sitting next to the bodies and was arrested on the spot. The motive behind the killings is not yet known. Wife demands death penalty for husband Crying, the wife Reshma said that her husband should be given the death penalty immediately. She stated that they had a love marriage in 2014, but he would beat her daily under the influence of alcohol. He had installed CCTV cameras from the entrance to the kitchen and bedroom and would not allow her to enter the room. He stayed inside with the two daughters, and she could only watch the room’s footage on a screen from outside. He would often tell her to leave with their son, saying he would raise the daughters himself. Husband used to get drunk and beat wife Reshma said, “I am from Siliguri, Bengal. My husband is from Bihar. I worked at a men's parlor in Kanpur. During that time, I met Shashi Ranjan Mishra. We had a love marriage in 2014. The relationship deteriorated after the wedding. He wouldn't let me go to my parents' house. He would always come home drunk and beat me. He always told me to go away with my son and that he would take care of both our daughters.' She said, 'If I went out, they wouldn't even let me come back home. I went to my parents' house with my son. They wouldn't let me take my daughters with me. Then, I couldn't bear to be without my daughters, and returned to my in-laws' house after about nine months. My husband always said, "My mother is dead. Now I want to die too. I'll take both our daughters with me. You raise your son.' She said, 'My husband used to take sleeping pills along with alcohol. I don't know what he was doing. He wouldn't let anyone into his room. When he went out, we would go into the room.' Went to sleep with daughters at 2.30 am in the night The wife said, ‘Everything was fine last night. He ate dinner and went to sleep with his daughters. He spoke to someone on the phone for a long time. I was watching everything in his room on the camera screen outside. Around 2:30 am in the night, he took his daughter to the washroom. Then, after a while, he took his daughter back to his room. He turned off the lights.’ 'Then I went to the door and windows of his room and listened, but I heard no movement or sound. I assumed everyone was asleep. After that, I don't know when the murder took place.'

stories.title: Heatwave alert in 6 cities of UP, temperatures cross 40°C:IMD advises people to stay indoors
stories.summary: Severe heat is prevailing in UP. The temperature in 26 districts has reached 40C or more. Bright sunshine emerged in most districts from morning on Sunday. Due to low wind speed, humidity is being felt. The roads are deserted. Talking about the last 24 hours, Banda was the third hottest city in the country. The maximum temperature was recorded at 44.6C. A day earlier, that is on Friday, Banda was the hottest city in Asia. Then the maximum temperature was recorded at 45.4C. This time, the heat has started showing its effect about 10 days earlier than normal. Last year, the temperature crossed 45C for the first time on April 27, whereas this time this situation has occurred in mid-April itself. The Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a heat-wave alert today in Banda, Chitrakoot, Kaushambi, Prayagraj and nearby districts of eastern UP. People have been advised to stay indoors and go out during afternoon only if absolutely necessary. Lucknow meteorological scientist Atul Singh said- Due to the effect of the anti-cyclone formed around Maharashtra, there will be an increase of 2-3C in temperature during the next 2-3 days. The temperature of most districts will reach 45C or above. There is a possibility of heat waves in some places in eastern UP. Currently, there is no hope of relief from the heat in the remaining days of April. 3-day heat wave warning in UP Heatwave may persist for a long time According to IMD's forecast, heatwave conditions may persist for a long time in some areas this year. This means that temperatures may remain very high for several consecutive days in many cities and people may have to face intense heat. When is it considered a heatwave? According to the Meteorological Department, a heatwave is considered when the temperature in plains reaches 40 degrees Celsius or more, or when the temperature is recorded 4 to 6 degrees above normal. In such conditions, people's health can also be affected and the risk of heatstroke increases. What are El-Nio and La-Nia? Does cold food mean 'cold things kept in the fridge'? No, 'cooling food' means those that keep the body cool from inside and have a cooling nature. For example- Foods like watermelon, cucumber, bottle gourd, curd and buttermilk have a cooling nature. They keep the body hydrated and help in balancing body temperature. Whereas cold drinks, cold coffee or very cold water from the fridge provide coolness for a few minutes, but they do not cool the body from inside.

stories.title: BJP MLA injured while trying to burn Akhilesh, Rahul effigies:SP chief Akhilesh Yadav takes a dig on social media
stories.summary: BJP MLA Anupama Jaiswal got burnt while burning effigies of Akhilesh Yadav and Rahul Gandhi in Bahraich. On Saturday at 1 PM, BJP workers were protesting regarding the Nari Shakti Vandan Act. As soon as the workers set fire to the effigy, flames flared up and reached the MLA's face. Her face and hair got singed. Workers and police personnel present at the spot immediately extinguished the fire with cloth. The MLA was immediately admitted to the district hospital for treatment. The incident occurred 50 meters away from the DM's residence. Anupama Jaiswal was the Minister of Basic Education and Women and Child Development for about 2 years during the first term of the Yogi government. SP chief Akhilesh Yadav has taken a dig at this matter. He shared a video on social media platform X and wrote- 'Those who set fire should be careful. Arrangements should be made for treatment of the woman who set the fire.' See 3 pictures of the incident... Protest at DM Chowk, Anupama Jaiswal was standing near the effigy In Bahraich on Saturday, BJP was protesting against opposition parties opposing the Nari Vandan Adhiniyam (Women's Reservation Act). Sadar MLA Anupama Jaiswal was also present. Effigies of SP chief Akhilesh Yadav and Congress leader Rahul Gandhi had been made. Workers were raising slogans against the opposition. Everyone stopped at the intersection 50 meters away from the DM residence to burn the effigy. Slogans were raised. Workers had surrounded the effigy from all sides. After this, oil was poured on the effigy. A woman worker was also asking everyone to move away. Just then, a worker set fire to the effigy. The flames went straight onto Anupama Jaiswal's face and hair. Workers and police personnel extinguished the fire with cloth. Anupama was taken away from the effigy. During this time, the effigy kept burning on the road. DM and SP reached the hospital The MLA was immediately taken to the district hospital, where doctors treated him. Upon receiving information about the incident, DM Akshay Tripathi and SP Vishwajeet Srivastava reached the hospital and inquired about the MLA's condition. During this time, a large number of BJP workers were also present at the hospital. Now know about Nari Shakti Vandan Act... On April 17, 2026, during a special session of Parliament, the 131st Constitutional Amendment Bill related to women's reservation was defeated in the Lok Sabha. This bill was rejected for the 7th time in 30 years, when the government failed to gather the necessary two-thirds majority to pass it. This time in the voting, 298 votes were cast in its favor, while 230 votes were against it. This bill was linked to delimitation along with providing 33% reservation to women. Opposition parties had demanded immediate implementation of reservation without census and delimitation, while the government presented it linked with these. This was the first time in 12 years of rule that the Modi government could not pass any bill in the House. Earlier, Amit Shah had said in a one-hour speech in the Lok Sabha that if these bills are not passed, the opposition will be responsible. After the bills fell through, the BJP has made this an issue. Protests are being held against the opposition at various places.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Train delays leave many stranded in homeguard exam; Iran shares war 'views' with Pak
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. Iran shares 'views, considerations' with Pak on ending war Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has released a statement following his meeting with Pakistan's head of armed forces, Asim Munir. The statement says they discussed "the latest developments related to the ceasefire" between Iran and US. 2. ₹300 electricity bill rises to ₹60,000: Residents smell faulty meters Consumers allege that even after depositing money, they are having to wait 5–6 hours and in many cases an entire day for electricity supply to be restored. A ground team visited to understand people’s problems. Here is what consumers had to say. 3. Homeguard exam sees huge turnout: Train delays leave many stranded The examination for recruitment to 42,000 Home Guard posts in Uttar Pradesh began on Saturday morning at 10 am with the first shift. Entry was allowed only after strict checking at examination centres. Candidates were subjected to retina scanning and biometric verification before entering the centres. 4. BJP releases photos of Kejriwal’s new 'Sheeshmahal-like' home The BJP on Saturday released pictures of former Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal’s residence at 95 Lodhi Estate. Delhi Minister Pravesh Verma alleged that the ‘Sheeshmahal’ (palace of mirrors) mindset still remains with him. He claimed crores of rupees had been spent to make the government residence luxurious. 5. Shopkeeper burnt alive as fire breaks out in Kanpur market A massive fire broke out in three shops in Kanpur’s Dina Market in Ghatampur at around 3:30 am on Saturday, killing a shopkeeper after he was burnt alive, while five family members suffered burn injuries. Fire brigade personnel used ladders to rescue those trapped on the first floor, and five fire tenders have been battling the blaze for the past five hours. 6. Mau family returning from daughter's wedding killed in car crash Five people, including a couple and their son, were killed in a horrific road accident in Uttar Pradesh’s Mau early on Saturday. The family was returning to Gorakhpur in a Scorpio after their daughter’s wedding in Ranchi when the vehicle suddenly went out of control at around 3 am on the highway, broke through the divider and entered the opposite lane, where it collided head-on with an oncoming trailer. 7. Indian investors become ₹7 lakh crore poorer in 3 days Indian investors have lost over ₹7 lakh crore by investing in India's stock market in the last three days. For three days in a row—from Wednesday, 22 April to Friday, 24 April, 2026, the Sensex fell by over 2,600 points, and the Nifty 50 dropped below the important 24,000 level. 8. Samajwadi Party shifts caste strategy from Purvanchal to Western UP for 2027 polls Samajwadi Party is giving a new direction to its caste-based electoral strategy for the 2027 Assembly elections. The party has appointed Rajbhar community leader Seema Rajbhar as the National President of the Women’s Wing and Rukmani Devi Nishad, sister of Phoolan Devi, as the State President of the Women’s Wing, in an attempt to strengthen its hold in Purvanchal. 9. Brij Bhushan Singh claims no representation of Thakurs in govt, sparks political debate Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections are due in about a year. Ahead of this, former BJP MP Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh has started mobilizing the Kshatriya community. 10. Man arrested for demanding obscene photos from Akshay’s daughter Maharashtra Cyber Police have arrested one person in connection with the case of demanding nude pictures from Bollywood actor Akshay Kumar’s daughter. Additional Director General of Police (ADGP) of Maharashtra Cyber, Yashasvi Yadav, informed about the arrest on Friday.

stories.title: LSG admit batting struggles, seek right combination:KKR’s Anukul Roy confident ahead of Ekana clash in Lucknow
stories.summary: At Ekana Stadium, Lucknow Super Giants (LSG) and Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) addressed the media ahead of their clash. LSG spin coach Carl Crowe admitted the batting unit has not performed to expectations. “The players know it better than anyone. But there’s intense work happening—long net sessions, constant discussions. We believe we’re just one good innings away. The quality is there,” he said. From KKR, Anukul Roy highlighted the value of consistent opportunities. “Regular chances build confidence. My preparation remains the same—I focus on what the game demands. I’m feeling good,” he said. LSG searching for right combination Crowe said while preparation is key, adaptability matters more. “You can only prepare to a point. Conditions change, so adapting on the day is crucial.” On opening combinations, he added that strategies depend on opposition plans, and the team is still trying to find its best, consistent XI. Focus on game, not pitch labels Speaking about pitch conditions, Crowe downplayed excessive discussion around surfaces. “Whether it’s red soil or black soil, focusing too much on it can limit you. It’s better to adapt to what’s in front of you.” Bowlers showing promise Crowe defended the bowling unit, citing high-scoring conditions in recent matches. He praised Ravi Bishnoi for his economical spell in the last game and noted that other bowlers have also delivered solid performances despite challenging scenarios. Anukul added that the team remains confident despite fluctuating results. “Wins and losses are part of the game. Our focus is to give our best. The bowlers are doing well, batting is improving, and a calm mindset helps performance,” he said.

stories.title: Suspected terrorist Tushar’s father says will shoot him if guilty:Held by ATS in Noida; Grandfather was soldier of Azad Hind Fauj
stories.summary: The youth from Meerut, Tushar Chauhan alias Hizbullah Ali Khan, who was arrested by ATS on charges of working as an ISI agent, had a grandfather who was a freedom fighter. He was an active soldier of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose's Azad Hind Fauj (Indian National Army). Tushar's father, Shailendra Chauhan, said he cannot believe that his son is a traitor. "If it is proven, I will shoot him myself," he stated. Former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi had also given a copper plate (Tamra Patra) to his father as a mark of honor. The father also claimed that his son has been suffering from ADHD, i.e., Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder, since childhood. He cannot do any of his work himself. In fact, on April 23, ATS had arrested Tushar (20) and his associate Sameer Khan from Noida on charges of connection with ISI. First, know what ATS said According to ATS, Tushar Chauhan and his associate Sameer Khan work for ISI. Both used to work for Pakistani gangsters Shahzad Bhatti and Abid Jatt. They also worked for Pakistani radical YouTubers. From Pakistan, they were offered to recce sensitive areas and throw hand grenades at influential people. For this, they received an advance of Rs 50,000. After the completion of the task, Rs 2.5 lakh were to be received. 14-day police remand approved ATS presented both in court on Thursday and sought remand. The court approved the application and granted 14-day police remand. The agency claims that by interrogating them for 14 days, they will find answers to many unsolved questions. Additionally, their network also needs to be investigated. It is suspected that some more people might be active like them. Now know about Tushar's family Tushar's family originally hails from Ramala, Baghpat. Besides his father Shailendra Chauhan, his mother Ritu Chauhan is also in the family. Shailendra Chauhan is associated with real estate. He shifted from Baghpat to Dehradun in 1995. About 10 years after shifting there, his son Tushar was born on May 5, 2006. In 2023, Shailendra shifted from Dehradun to Meerut with his family. Here, he was living in rented houses at different locations. About 20 days ago, he shifted to a house in Vaishno Dham Colony, Kanker Khera. Tushar's father Shailendra Chauhan and mother Ritu Chauhan have completely denied the claim of their son's arrest from Noida. In a conversation with Dainik Bhaskar, Shailendra Chauhan said that on April 20, a call came. The caller said - a courier has arrived but the address is not found. Initially, he said that he had not ordered any courier, but then he told the caller his home location. Three people came to the house. As soon as the door opened, all three came inside and took his son, who was eating, into custody. Shailendra says that the people who came to the house said that illegal and anti-national content was found on Tushar's phone. They are taking him for questioning. If the matter turns out to be false, they will release him, but if it turns out to be true, they will deposit him there. On April 22, a call came from the same ATS sub-inspector, who informed that they were presenting Tushar before the court on Thursday, so they should come to Lucknow. His wife is ill, so he did not go himself and sent his acquaintances there. The court sent Tushar to jail. Family said - Tushar is mentally ill According to father Shailendra, Tushar has been suffering from ADHD, i.e., Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder, since childhood. He also underwent treatment for a long time, but he became a victim of Conduct Disorder, i.e., behavioral disorder. He also showed some prescriptions from the World Brain Center Hospital in Delhi, which indicated that Tushar had this illness. Father showed prescriptions from different hospitals

stories.title: Policemen driving Thar run over retired registrar in Bundelkhand University:Victim's scooty dragged 20 metres; see pictures
stories.summary: In Bundelkhand University, Jhansi, 4 policemen in a THAR vehicle ran over a retired Assistant Registrar. After dragging him for 20 meters, his scooter got stuck under the THAR. Retired Assistant Registrar Maniram Verma (70) was trapped under the front wheel of the THAR. After this, the policemen stopped the THAR. Then they abandoned the vehicle and fled. Security guards, with the help of others, removed the THAR. Maniram Verma was taken to the medical college, where doctors declared him dead. Nawababad police have seized the THAR and started an investigation. Eyewitnesses stated that a Home Guard exam was ongoing in the examination building at the university. The policemen had left from there in the THAR. They were driving the four-wheeler at high speed inside the campus. See 3 pictures Read full story in detail Was going to buy household items Maniram Verma (70), son of Banshidhar, was a resident of Bhadarwara village in the Erach police station area. He had retired from Bundelkhand University as an Assistant Registrar. He was currently living with his family on the university campus. His son, Girish Kumar, stated that on Saturday afternoon around 12 PM, his father Maniram left home on a scooter. He was going to buy items from a shop outside the campus. On the way, a black Thar vehicle, coming at high speed from the direction of the examination building inside the campus, collided with the scooter. There were 4 policemen in khaki uniforms sitting in the Thar vehicle. They abandoned the vehicle and fled after the accident. Upon receiving the information, we reached the spot. By then, the staff had already taken father to the hospital. When we reached the medical college from there, we found out that father had passed away. Dad was crushed under the wheel A Home Guard exam was going on in the examination building about 100 meters away from the accident site. According to eyewitnesses, the Thar vehicle was coming from this direction. Hearing a loud bang, people nearby reached the spot. But by then, 4 policemen in uniform had picked up bags from inside the car and fled. The scooter was stuck under the Thar vehicle. The front wheel of the Thar was on top of Maniram Verma. Upon receiving information, the police reached the spot and somehow removed the Thar vehicle. After this, the injured person was taken to the medical college, where he was declared dead. Police have seized the Thar vehicle and the scooter and started an investigation.

stories.title: Kanpur teen inspired by Crime Patrol kills lecturer’s wife:Flees with ₹27 lakh jewellery; arrested in 3 days
stories.summary: Police in Kanpur on Saturday solved the robbery-cum-murder case of a lecturer’s wife in Kalyanpur, arresting the main accused—19-year-old Ishu Sharma alias Aryan—and recovering jewellery worth around ₹27 lakh. During interrogation, the accused said he wanted to “become a big man quickly” and often watched crime-based TV shows like Crime Patrol, from which he drew inspiration. He entered the victim’s house, murdered her, and fled with valuables. According to police, the accused deliberately avoided using a mobile phone or vehicle to reduce the chances of being traced. He also believed committing the crime alone would lower the risk of arrest. Despite this, investigators tracked him down using CCTV footage. How the case unfolded DCP West SM Kasim Abidi, addressing a press conference, said the incident took place on April 23 in Awas Vikas-1, Kalyanpur. The victim, 55-year-old Nirmala—wife of lecturer Harendra Singh—was found murdered with her throat slit. Jewellery worth ₹27 lakh was reported missing from the house. A case was registered immediately, and multiple police teams were deployed. CCTV trail led to arrest Police scanned footage from over 500 CCTV cameras and spotted a youth wearing a saffron towel leaving the house. Based on this lead, 12 teams traced the suspect within three days. The accused was identified and arrested near Ganesh Nagar Salt Factory, where he lived. Police matched his height, build, and appearance with the CCTV footage before taking him into custody. All the stolen jewellery has been recovered, and further legal proceedings are underway. The DCP said that the cunning Ishu Sharma alias Aryan is originally a resident of village Khiriyanpur, Moosanagar police station, Kanpur Dehat district. Currently, he was living in a rented room in Ganesh Nagar with his father suffering from mouth cancer and his mother, while his two brothers and sister live in the village. During interrogation, initially the cunning one kept evading, because he had left his mobile at home before going to commit the crime, due to which his location was also not matching. After the police confirmed his identity based on the saffron towel and clothes and his physique, they started strict interrogation and he broke down within a short time. The criminal revealed that he wanted to become a big man in a short time. He had studied only up to intermediate level, due to which he could not get any big job other than labor work. The special thing he mentioned was that he is fond of watching Crime Patrol and other crime serials. From this, he got the idea that in the neighborhood where he used to live, an elderly couple lived alone. Because of this, he entered the house by giving the false pretext of a drone falling on the roof and even went up to the terrace, and during this time he saw that only a woman was at home. After strangling elderly Nirmala Devi, he slit her throat with a knife. After this, one locker of the cupboard was already open and he found the key to the second locker in the room itself. He opened the second locker with the key and collected all the jewelry from both lockers and put it in a bag. After this, to hide his identity, he covered his face with a towel and left the house. The criminal reached his home on foot from the crime scene so that no one could trace him. After confessing to the murder, the police recovered all the looted jewelry from his house. On Saturday, after presenting him in court, he was sent to jail. Jewelry hidden in toilet pipe The DCP said that the murder case was solved, but the cunning accused was not revealing anything about the jewelry. The police took him to the spot and after strict interrogation, he revealed that the jewelry was hidden in the toilet pipe on the roof. He had tied the jewelry in a cloth bundle and hung it in the pipe by tying it with a wire. When the police pulled the wire and took out the bundle, all the jewelry was recovered. There was a plan to murder both, coincidentally the lecturer was not found Police said that the criminal previously lived in a rented house in the same neighborhood. During bat-ball games, the ball would often go into that house and he would go there. He knew that only an elderly couple lived in the house. Because of this, he plotted to rob after murdering both of them and entered the house on the pretext of a drone falling, and coincidentally the elderly lecturer had gone out of the house to get some items. Due to this, after murdering the woman, he carried out the crime and then fled from there. This jewelry was recovered

stories.title: Contractor shot in mouth in Gorakhpur:Married 14 years ago, young son tells mother, ‘Don’t cry, I’ll care of family’
stories.summary: Don't cry Mom, I will take care of the entire family, I have learned a lot from Papa... When innocent son Ishan said this while holding his crying mother's hand, everyone who heard it broke down in tears. His grandfather grabbed the innocent child and embraced him. Ambrish married Deepali in June 2012. While Ambrish's birthday also fell on June 11. His wife said that they used to celebrate the birthday and wedding anniversary together. The sudden death of Ambrish Srivastava (40), a resident of Park Road in Gorakhpur, has cast deep sorrow over the entire family and neighborhood. When his body reached his residence around 4 in the evening on Friday after the post-mortem, there was an outburst of wailing among the relatives present there. The atmosphere at home became extremely sorrowful. As soon as the family members saw Ambrish's body, tears from his elderly father's eyes wouldn't stop flowing. He broke down seeing his son's corpse. Meanwhile, younger brother Nitin and both sons clung to their father's body and started crying. Seeing this painful scene of the family, every person present there had moist eyes. Ambrish's younger son Veer kept sobbing while clinging to his uncle Nitin. Seeing his nephew wailing like this, Nitin too couldn't control himself and started crying while holding him to his chest. The women and relatives standing around became emotional seeing the children's pain. Wife said, ‘What will happen to children’ When the body was being taken to Rajghat for the last rites, during the final viewing, Ambarish's wife Deepali, clinging to her sister-in-law Parul Srivastava and crying, kept repeatedly saying what would happen to her and the children now. Meanwhile, their elder son Ishan held his mother's hand and said, "Mom, don't cry, I am here. I will take care of the entire family." The son's words with tears in his eyes moved everyone present there. On the other hand, the younger son kept clinging to his uncle and repeatedly asking, "What happened to Papa? Wake him up, uncle." Hearing this, the hearts of those present were shattered. After the news of Ambarish's death, hundreds of people including the city's prominent businessmen, public representatives, student leaders and acquaintances reached his Park Road residence to pay their last respects. As soon as his body arrived at the residence around four o'clock on Friday afternoon, the crowd of people already present there increased further. Suddenly came the sound of a gunshot During police interrogation, it was revealed that on Friday morning, Ambarish Srivastava reached the third floor of the building at the Kusamhi farmhouse while talking on the phone. According to the employees, he was continuously talking to someone and went upstairs during that time. It is being said that this was his last conversation, which possibly took place with a family member. Shortly after this, the sound of gunfire was heard. Upon reaching the spot, he was already dead. Had obtained pistol license a year and a half ago Ambrish Srivastava had received his pistol license about a year and a half ago. It is being said that he often kept his licensed pistol with him. On Friday, the pistol was present with him at the farmhouse located in Kusamhi. According to preliminary information, he died from a bullet fired from the same pistol. Appeared somewhat distressed upon reaching the farmhouse Ambarish reached his farmhouse located in Kusamhi around 8:00 on Friday morning. He had gone there alone. According to the employees present at the farmhouse, he appeared somewhat disturbed and worried at that time. Upon arrival, he first looked at the cows and talked with the employees for some time. After this, he slowly went towards the roof of the building, where the shooting incident later came to light. SP City Nimish Patil said- On the morning of April 24 at 9:30 AM, Ambarish's younger brother Nitin Srivastava called and informed about the death. He said that Ambarish had gone to the farmhouse in the morning when the accident occurred. The police reached the spot and conducted an investigation. In the CCTV installed at the scene, Ambarish was seen arriving in his Fortuner and going to the roof. Ambarish's father Atul Srivastava is a big businessman in the city. He has a tent house business under the name 'AK'. He has also been the president of the Shri Chitragupta Temple Committee of Kayasthas. Ambarish had also recently been elected as the General Secretary of the Shri Chitragupta Temple Committee. 5 pictures related to incident Farmhouse is 10 km away from home Ambarish's house is on Park Road in the posh area of Civil Lines. 10km away from his house, he has a three-story farmhouse in Kusmi forest. On the third floor of this, there are 3-4 rooms. In the front empty section, there is a terrace. Tents and chairs-tables are kept in the warehouse. Ambarish was the elder of two brothers. His younger brother Nitin alias Ranu is also a businessman. Ambarish went to sleep in his Civil Lines house itself on Thursday night after having dinner. He woke up on Friday morning and called the driver to go to the farmhouse, but the driver didn't come. He kept walking around in the house for an hour. Then he left on his own taking the Fortuner. After reaching there, he called someone. While talking, he went up to the third floor. Around between 8:30 to 9 o'clock, hearing the sound of gunfire, the employees came running. When they looked there, Ambarish was lying drenched in blood. The bullet had exited through his mouth. During the incident, around 4 employees were present there. Got married in 2012, has two sons Ambrish married Deepali Srivastava in 2012. They have two sons - one is 10 years old and the other is 8 years old. Ambrish was in the tent house business as well as contracting work. His tents were used in events of prominent leaders and VVIP people. Ambrish also owned a hotel named FIVE SENSES on Taramandal Road in Gorakhpur. It also has a banquet and restaurant. BJP State President expressed grief BJP State President Pankaj Chaudhary has expressed condolences on the demise of the businessman. He said that I am deeply saddened by the demise of Gorakhpur businessman Ambarish Srivastava. In this hour of grief, my deepest sympathies are with the bereaved family members. I pray to God to grant the departed soul a place at His holy feet. May He grant the family members strength to bear this immense sorrow.

stories.title: Yogi Adityanath says no iftar on streets in UP:Alleges TMC opposed CAA to curb Hindu population growth
stories.summary: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath held an election rally in Nadia district of West Bengal on Saturday. During campaigning for the Nabadwip assembly seat, he said, “TMC had opposed the CAA. This law will grant Indian citizenship to Hindus, Buddhists, and Jains who came distressed from Pakistan and Bangladesh.” “But, Mamata Didi feels bad that if there are more Hindus, how will iftar parties happen on the streets. In UP, no one can hold iftar parties on the streets, cannot offer namaz, and no sound comes from mosques,” he added. Read the key points from CM Yogi's speech 1. Had to approach High Court for Durga Puja CM Yogi said, "At the time of Bengal partition, Vande Mataram had become a weapon for every Bengali, but Mamata Didi is irritated by all this. She has a problem with people saying Jai Shri Ram in Bengal. The Kolkata High Court had to order that those who are creating disorder during Durga Puja should be stopped. This government, which has become a symbol of mafia raj in Bengal, is not ready to listen to anything. You must have seen the day before yesterday how TMC goons were attacking BJP workers. On May 4th, when the results come, these goons will have no place to hide. 2. 'There is no curfew in UP, no riots, everything is fine in UP' CM Yogi said - Once Bengal had the highest contribution to India's economy. Daughters and sisters used to be safe, but now goonda tax is being collected. Cattle mafia, sand mafia, land mafia are increasing. The money that Modi ji sends from Delhi, TMC goons use that money to support their families. Until 2017, the situation in UP was the same. Traders were migrating, incidents of love jihad and land jihad were increasing, lathis and bullets were fired for saying Jai Shri Ram. Today there is a double engine government in UP. Today there is no curfew in UP, no riots, everything is fine in UP. 3. Bengal faces an identity crisis CM Yogi said - The Bengal which gave India its identity, today faces an identity crisis. The TMC government has become a symbol of mafia raj, terror and corruption in 15 years. Its goons are roaming openly. The CM said that two days ago, in the first phase of voting, people cast their votes in record numbers. From what is being heard now, from what scenes are visible, when the results come on May 4, saffron flags will be seen waving everywhere. 4. 'UP's bulldozer buries the mafia in the dust' CM Yogi said - A grand temple has been built at Lord Ram's birthplace in Ayodhya. Congress, Communists and TMC could not stop it. Ropeways are being built in UP now, expressways are being built. Every person has a guarantee of security. The CM said - UP's bulldozer doesn't just build expressways, it also buries the mafia's bones and ribs in the dust. Mamata Didi says 'Khela Hobe' (the game will happen), we say that now Bengal has awakened. Now the game is over, progress has begun. Now a double engine government will work in Bengal.

stories.title: Homeguard exam sees huge turnout:Train delays leave many stranded; candidates battle heat at 55 centres
stories.summary: A massive turnout was witnessed in Lucknow as the UP Homeguard recruitment exam began on Friday, drawing thousands of candidates to centres across the city. However, the day also saw significant disruptions, with hundreds of aspirants missing their exam due to train delays. The Begumpura Express, running behind schedule due to technical issues, left many candidates unable to reach their centres on time. Despite the scorching heat, candidates showed up in large numbers, many covering their heads with towels to cope with the conditions. Authorities have set up around 55 examination centres in the city for nearly 1.33 lakh candidates. stories.title: Lover strangles woman to death in Lucknow:Absconds on the pretext of brining medicine leaving daughter behind
stories.summary: In Lucknow, a woman was allegedly killed by her lover, who strangled her and fled the scene after leaving the body at the house. Police reached the spot on information and sent the body for post-mortem. The incident took place late Friday night near Lala Bagh on Ring Road under Thakurganj police station area. The deceased has been identified as Neelam Saxena (42). The woman was living in a temporary hut built on an empty plot along with her lover and her 8-year-old daughter. Her body was found in the same plot on Saturday morning. Marriage took place 15 years ago According to the victim’s brother Naresh, Neelam was married 15 years ago to Sanjay Saxena, a resident of Gaur Atrauli in Hardoi. The couple had four daughters — Shivani, Pranshi, Madhu and Nidhi. Earlier, the family lived in a rented house in Balaganj. About four months ago, Neelam separated from her husband. She then started living with Sanjay Gautam from Kaundiya, Atrauli, Hardoi, along with her youngest daughter Nidhi. The couple was living in a hut on an empty plot near Noble Hospital in Lala Bagh, Ring Road area of Thakurganj. The three elder daughters were staying at their maternal home. Strangled while sleeping The victim’s daughter Nidhi said that on Friday night, after having dinner, her mother went to sleep. During the night, Sanjay Gautam allegedly strangled her. He reportedly told the girl that he was going to bring medicine and left the house. He did not return. The child fell asleep and later found her mother dead in the morning. No injury marks found on the body Police said that information about the death was given at 3:30 am on Saturday by Naresh, a resident of Hiyatganj, Atrauli, Hardoi. Police reached the spot and carried out an investigation. No visible injury marks were found on the body. A forensic team collected evidence from the scene. Officials said there is no clear evidence of murder at this stage. It has also come to light that the deceased was reportedly addicted to alcohol. All angles are being investigated, and the exact cause of death will be confirmed after the post-mortem report, which will decide further legal action.

stories.title: UP Home Guard recruitment exam begins at 1053 centres:25 lakh candidates appear for 42,000 posts amid strict biometric checks
stories.summary: The examination for recruitment to 42,000 Home Guard posts in Uttar Pradesh began on Saturday morning at 10 am with the first shift. Entry was allowed only after strict checking at examination centres. Candidates were subjected to retina scanning and biometric verification before entering the centres. In Jaunpur, candidates were made to remove their shoes. In Sambhal, religious threads (kalawa) were cut. Shoes, belts, bangles and amulets were also removed during the checking process. The examination has started at 1053 centres across the state and will continue for three days till 27 April. Around 25 lakh candidates are expected to appear. The state police has been placed on high alert for the duration of the exam. The exam will carry 100 marks and will include multiple-choice questions. The duration of the examination is 2 hours. UP Police Recruitment Board Chairman SB Shiradkar said that examination centres have been set up in all districts except Shravasti. See pictures... Board had earlier issued instructions During earlier recruitment exams, incidents of removal of religious symbols like kalawa and mangalsutra had led to controversy. The UP Police Recruitment and Promotion Board had then issued clear instructions that religious and cultural symbols such as kalawa and mangalsutra should not be removed. It had warned that disciplinary action would be taken against those found violating these instructions to prevent such incidents in future.

stories.title: Pregnant girlfriend killed in Prayagraj:Boyfriend Monish Patel admits to slamming down, strangling her after argument over marriage
stories.summary: “I have been in a physical relationship with you for one and a half years. I have become pregnant. The child in my womb is yours. Now you are going to marry another girl. You keep lying repeatedly. You used to say you will convince your family, otherwise we will run away and get married. Either marry me, or let us run away together. I will die, but I will not leave you.” This warning was given by a girl from Prayagraj to her lover Monish Patel, who later killed her. Monish has disclosed all details to the police. ACP Phulpur Vivek Yadav said that on 23 April, the body of a 20-year-old girl was found a short distance from her home. There were injury marks on her neck and face. In this case, Monish and two others have been arrested. How love turned into murder ACP said that 24-year-old Monish Patel and the girl had been in a relationship for two years. Their houses were just 20 metres apart. After studying till Class 8, the girl had stopped going to school. Their affair was known in the village, and even Monish’s family was not in favour of the relationship. Meanwhile, Monish kept promising marriage. About one and a half years ago, the relationship became physical. He would often call her to meet. At night, they used to meet in fields or empty plots away from the village. When they could not meet, they stayed in touch through phone calls and chats. Beaten by family three months ago Police interrogation revealed that three months ago, Monish called the girl to meet at night. Her family got to know about this and the next day, relatives and family members beat Monish badly. Even then, Monish’s family clearly said they would not allow marriage with the girl. Despite this, their contact continued. Meanwhile, Monish’s marriage was fixed elsewhere by his family. The wedding was scheduled in June. However, Monish hid this from the girl and continued promising marriage. Their meetings continued. Threat led to murder During police interrogation, Monish said he was shocked when the girl told him she was pregnant. The girl started insisting that he marry her. Monish no longer wanted to marry her and tried to distance himself, but the situation worsened. The girl threatened that she would go to the police station and reveal everything. This frightened Monish. On the night of 22 April, Monish called her to meet. He tried to convince her, and when she did not agree, he threatened her. Even then, the girl refused to accept anything. She said she would go to the police and also inform the family where his marriage was fixed. After this, Monish pushed her down, sat on her, and strangled her to death. Postmortem confirmed that the girl was two months pregnant. Two brothers abroad, 4 tractors at home ACP Phulpur Vivek Yadav said Monish comes from a wealthy farming family. His father is a big farmer and the family owns four tractors, which Monish operates. His two brothers work in Saudi Arabia. The family earns well from agriculture. In contrast, the girl’s family is poor. Her father works on others’ farmland, and her brother also does share-cropping. Father and brother also made accused ACP said Monish’s father, 65-year-old Lal Bahadur Patel, and elder brother Vikas Patel have also been made accused in the murder case. They have been booked for conspiracy. Police said both knew about the relationship. They were aware that Monish used to meet the girl. They also knew about the murder but misled the police instead of informing them. Body found near the house The body was found on 23 April morning in Sandalpur Malehtua village of Prayagraj, about 10 metres from her house. There were deep injury marks on her face and head. Family said that on the night of 22 April, she had dinner with everyone and then went to sleep in her room. In the morning, when her younger brother went to wake her to feed the cow, she was not in the room. Later, her body was found about 10 metres away from the house.

stories.title: Youtuber Salim Vastik arrested after 25 years:Convicted in 1995 child kidnapping and killing of businessman’s 13-year-old son
stories.summary: Ghaziabad’s former ex-Muslim YouTuber Salim Vastik, who himself was earlier attacked and had his throat slit, has now been found to be a convicted murderer in a shocking revelation. Delhi Police arrested him on Saturday. He had been absconding for the past 25 years. Ghaziabad Police Commissioner J. Ravindra Gaur said that Delhi Police reached Salim’s residence on Saturday morning and took him away after questioning. According to Delhi Police officials, on 20 January 1995, Salim kidnapped 13-year-old Sandeep Bansal, son of a businessman in Delhi. After ransom demands were not met by the family, the boy was killed. Officials said Salim was arrested after the incident and sent to jail. In 1997, he was sentenced to life imprisonment. However, in 2000 he was granted bail, after which he went missing. Since then, he had been living under different identities across Shamli, Muzaffarnagar, Meerut, and Ghaziabad. The YouTuber who left Islam was stabbed 14 times Background of the murder case Delhi Police stated that Salim had kidnapped the 13-year-old son of a businessman on 20 January 1995. After ransom was not paid, the child was murdered. He was arrested and later sentenced to life imprisonment in 1997. He was released on bail in 2000 and then absconded. For the past 25 years, he had been changing identities and living in different cities of western Uttar Pradesh.

stories.title: Samajwadi Party shifts caste strategy for 2027 polls:Focus moves from Purvanchal to Western UP challenge
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party is giving a new direction to its caste-based electoral strategy for the 2027 Assembly elections. The party has appointed Rajbhar community leader Seema Rajbhar as the National President of the Women’s Wing and Rukmani Devi Nishad, sister of Phoolan Devi, as the State President of the Women’s Wing, in an attempt to strengthen its hold in Purvanchal. Now, the SP’s focus has shifted to Western Uttar Pradesh. This region has always been the party’s weak link. In the 2022 Assembly elections, SP failed to win even a single seat in 12 districts of this region, despite being in alliance with the Rashtriya Lok Dal (RLD). Even the Yadav-Muslim equation has not delivered significant results here. What is the reason behind this? Read the full report. Why SP remains weak in Western UP Senior journalist Rajendra Kumar explains that Western UP has around 15% Jat and 20% Dalit population. The BJP-RLD alliance has a strong hold over Jats, while BSP and Chandrashekhar’s influence is strong among Jatav-Dalits. Another major factor is the 2013 Muzaffarnagar riots, which created a deep divide between Jats, Gurjars, Jatavs, and Muslims. The Muslim-Yadav (M-Y) equation also does not have a major impact here. The Jat-Gurjar-Dalit combination largely remains in favour of the BJP. This time, under its PDA formula, SP is trying to bring together Gurjars, Muslims, and non-Jatav Dalits to make inroads into the Jat-Jatav vote base, especially in constituencies where BJP is strong. This is why SP is searching for leaders from Jat and Dalit communities who can increase its vote share. SP failed to open account in 12 districts of Western UP in 2022 Senior journalist Rajendra Kumar further explains that Jats and Jatav communities have traditionally stayed away from SP in Western UP. In the 2022 Assembly elections, due to the SP-RLD alliance, some Jats supported SP. Out of 136 seats in Western UP, SP won 35 and RLD won 8. Without any alliance, BJP managed to win 93 seats, which is about 69% of the total. In 12 districts including Bulandshahr, Hapur, Agra, Mathura, and Etah, SP could not win a single seat. In the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, when RLD aligned with BJP, the BJP’s position became even stronger. Out of 27 Lok Sabha seats in Western UP, BJP-RLD won 15, while SP managed 10. Similarly, Jatav Dalits have never been aligned with SP. This vote bank has traditionally been dominated by Mayawati. With BSP weakening and Chandrashekhar’s Azad Samaj Party gaining strength, this vote shifted further. A section of non-Jatav Dalits also moved towards BJP. In the Lok Sabha elections, SP fielded Dalit candidates in seats like Ayodhya and Meerut. While SP won in Ayodhya, it narrowly lost Meerut by around 10,000 votes. Now, SP may attempt a similar experiment in the upcoming Assembly elections. However, Mayawati is regaining strength, and all parties are targeting Dalit votes. Therefore, SP is searching for influential Jatav leaders with strong presence across Western UP, or at least leaders with influence in individual districts. Eastern UP gives SP a 26-seat advantage Compared to Western UP, SP’s position in Eastern UP appears stronger. Out of 102 Assembly seats in the region, SP had won 31 seats. At that time, Om Prakash Rajbhar’s SBSP was also with Akhilesh Yadav, and the party had won 6 seats. Although BJP had won 53 seats, it failed to open its account in districts like Ghazipur and Azamgarh. By the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, Om Prakash Rajbhar had joined BJP, yet SP’s position remained strong. SP won 12 out of 21 Lok Sabha seats on its own, covering 56 Assembly segments. This meant SP gained a lead in 26 seats within two years. BJP won 8 Lok Sabha seats, covering 41 Assembly segments, meaning it fell behind in 12 seats during this period. This is why SP is focusing on strengthening its position in Eastern UP. Influential parties like Nishad Party and SBSP are currently aligned with BJP. To counter this, SP has appointed Seema Rajbhar as National President of Women’s Wing and Rukmani Devi Nishad, sister of Phoolan Devi, as State President. However, both are not major political figures. Still, by giving them key positions, SP aims to send a message of empowering backward-class women. Western UP remains a major challenge without alliance SP’s caste-based strategy now focuses on 136 seats in Western UP. In 2022, it benefited from RLD’s support, but this time it faces the challenge of contesting independently. That is why SP has already begun its campaign from Dadri. Apart from Jats, Gurjars are another important vote bank in Western UP. To attract them, SP held a “Samajwadi Samta Bhai-chara Rally” in Dadri on March 29. Considering the importance of the region, SP is also organizing its “Vision India” programme in Ghaziabad on April 25. This is a nationwide youth outreach campaign aimed at presenting the party’s roadmap for the 2027 elections. Another similar programme is planned in Noida by the end of May. Chandrashekhar alliance could change political equations Senior journalist Ravindra Singh Rana, who closely follows Western UP politics, says that if SP forms an alliance with Chandrashekhar, it could benefit significantly. A large section of Jatav voters is currently with Chandrashekhar. Among Jat leaders, SP has names like Harendra Malik, Pankaj Malik, and Samarpal Singh. In recent times, Akhilesh Yadav’s strategy of promoting young leaders is also showing results. For example, he recently praised Meerut-based young Jat leader Samrat Malik’s jacket, after which Malik arrived in Lucknow wearing a similar jacket, which was publicly highlighted by Akhilesh, sending a strong message among youth and the community.
